AI.method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅表明作者将"呈现这些阶段的综述"，涉及PWN早期膨胀进入未激波的超新星抛射物及其晚期与SNR反向激波的相互作用，并讨论PWN/SNR相互作用的多波段特征；未提及具体观测、仪器、频率、时间跨度或分析手段。
AI.result: 摘要未说明。摘要提出PWNe在特定演化阶段可能将粒子加速至PeV能量，是PeVatron候选体，并通过综述各演化阶段及PWN/SNR相互作用的多波段特征来阐述；但摘要未给出任何已报告的具体数值、事件或统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为PWN/SNR相互作用的多波段特征可揭示关于爆炸性质与粒子加速过程的关键信息，并支持PWNe作为潜在的PeVatron候选体。根据摘要无法判断。

title: IXPE Observations of Pulsar Wind Nebulae
summary: The Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE), launched on December 9, 2021, has, within its first four years of operation, successfully measured X-ray polarization in the 2─8 keV energy band for at least six Pulsar Wind Nebulae (PWNe): the Crab, Vela, MSH 15─52, B0540─69, 3C 58, and G21.5─0.9. Leveraging its imaging polarimetric capabilities, IXPE has enabled the first spatially resolved maps of X-ray polarization in PWNe, providing new constraints on the global magnetic-field structure and the level of turbulence within these systems. Owing to their strong synchrotron emission, PWNe have emerged as one of the most highly polarized classes of sources observed by IXPE to date, with polarization degrees in some cases approaching the theoretical maximum for synchrotron radiation. This indicates particle acceleration occurring in highly ordered magnetic fields. By isolating the nebular contribution, significant phase-resolved polarization from the embedded pulsars has also been detected in several cases. Although there is a general trend toward aligned polarization in young PWNe exhibiting jet─torus X-ray morphologies, the full population displays a wide range of polarization properties, suggesting underlying physical differences that are not yet fully understood. In this contribution, I will review the main results from IXPE observations of PWNe, highlighting both common patterns and key differences, and discussing their implications for particle acceleration and magnetic-field structure in these systems.

AI.abstract_translation: 成像X射线偏振测量探测器（IXPE）于2021年12月9日发射，在运行的前四年内，已成功在2─8 keV能带中测量了至少六个脉冲星风云（PWNe）的X射线偏振：蟹状星云（Crab）、船帆座（Vela）、MSH 15─52、B0540─69、3C 58和G21.5─0.9。凭借其成像偏振测量能力，IXPE实现了PWNe中X射线偏振的首个空间分辨图谱，为这些系统中的全局磁场结构和湍流水平提供了新的约束。由于具有强烈的同步辐射，PWNe已成为IXPE迄今观测到的偏振度最高的源类别之一，在某些情况下其偏振度接近同步辐射的理论最大值。这表明粒子加速发生在高度有序的磁场中。通过分离星云成分，在若干情形下也已探测到内嵌脉冲星显著的相位分辨偏振。尽管在具有喷流─环面X射线形态的年轻PWNe中存在偏振趋于对齐的普遍趋势，但整体星族展现出广泛的偏振特性，暗示其背后存在尚不完全理解的物理差异。在本次报告中，我将回顾IXPE对PWNe观测的主要结果，强调其共同模式与关键差异，并讨论它们对研究这些系统中粒子加速和磁场结构的启示。
AI.tldr: 该论文综述IXPE对至少六个脉冲星风云（Crab、Vela、MSH 15─52、B0540─69、3C 58和G21.5─0.9）的X射线偏振观测结果。PWNe是IXPE观测到的偏振度最高的源类别之一，偏振度接近同步辐射理论最大值，表明粒子加速发生在高度有序的磁場中。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在利用IXPE在2─8 keV能带的成像偏振测量能力，系统回顾其对脉冲星风云（PWNe）的观测结果，探究这些系统中的全局磁场结构和湍流水平，并厘清粒子加速与磁场结构之间的关系，以及解释年轻PWNe与整体星族之间的物理差异。
AI.method: 基于IXPE（于2021年12月9日发射）在运行前四年内对至少六个PWNe（Crab、Vela、MSH 15─52、B0540─69、3C 58和G21.5─0.9）在2─8 keV能带的X射线偏振观测，利用其成像偏振测量能力获取空间分辨的偏振图谱，并分离星云成分以探测内嵌脉冲星的偏振。摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度、样本统计量及详细分析方法细节。
AI.result: IXPE已成功测量至少六个PWNe在2─8 keV能带的X射线偏振，实现了首个空间分辨的偏振图谱，约束了磁场结构和湍流水平。PWNe是IXPE迄今观测到的偏振度最高的源类别之一，偏振度在某些情况下接近同步辐射理论最大值。在若干情形下探测到内嵌脉冲星显著的相位分辨偏振。年轻PWNe中整体呈偏振对齐趋势，但全星族展示出广泛的偏振特性差异。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出，接近同步辐射理论最大值的偏振度表明粒子加速发生在高度有序的磁場中。年轻PWNe存在偏振对齐的普遍趋势，但完整星族展现宽泛的偏振特性，暗示其背后尚未完全理解的物理差异。这些结果对研究PWNe中粒子加速和磁场结构具有重要意义。由于本文为综述性论述，摘要未提供具体物理机制判断，根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星或FRB的转移性结论。

title: Cosmological Distributions and Evolution of Gamma-ray Bursts and their relation to Star Formation Rate and Gravitational Waves
summary: Formation rate (FR) history of sources provide crucial information on how the universe emerged from the dark ages to its current stage. Best observed FR is that of stars (SFR) that rises from high redshifts to redshift of 3 and declines to today. Active galactic nuclei (AGNs) show a similar trend but with different parameters. Transient sources like gamma-ray bursts (GRBs), and to some degree fast radio bursts (FRBs), by virtue of their large redshifts are good candidates for determining this history and its relation to SFR. Methods: Achievement of this task requires determination of the "Luminosity Function" (LF) and the cosmological evolution of luminosity and FRs. This is often done by a forward fitting of the data to some assumed parametric forms for the LF and evolution, with many parameters, and often ignoring luminosity evolution. However, recent works use the non-parametric methods developed by Lynden-Bell and Efron and Petrosian (EP), which determines the luminosity evolution directly from "truncated" data. In this talk I will review past and more recent estimates of LFs and FR evolution, using theses methods, of GRBs and if time permits FRBs. Data: A critical issue here is to have samples with measured "fluxes" and redshifts (z) with well defined truncation determined by observational selection effects, which we call "complete samples". The main source for GRBs has been the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory with some data from Konus-Wind and Fermi-GBM. The main source for FRBs has been the CHIME radio telescope. A main uncertainty is the selection effects that redshift measurements introduce. As I will discuss use of Machine Learning (ML) to estimates redshifts can help in this regard. Theory: An important issue for the transient sources, which are often poorly localized is their progenitors. GRBs are divided into two groups; Long-soft and Short-hard. So-called collapsars are assumed to be the progenitors of GRBs, while SGRBs progenitors are believed to be neutron star(NS)-NS or NS-black hole mergers, which are also sources of gravitational waves (GWs) and Kilonovae. FRBs also come in two variety "repeaters" and "non-repeaters" with magnetars as likely progenitors. Results: GRBs consistently shown (1) presence of strong luminosity evolution,a broken power-law LF and varied formation rate evolution. Collapsars, being short lived stars are expected to follow the SFR. We find that LGRBs seem to follow the SFR at high-z's but deviate significantly from it, as a low low-z component that increase with decreasing-z. SGRBs show a increasing FR up to lowest z's similar to delayed SFR expected from compact object mergers, similar to the low-z component of LGRB. These finding raise doubt about the standard separation by duration of GRBs and affects the expected frequency of GWs and Kilonovae. FRBs also show luminosity evolution and a delayed FR supporting the magnetar origin. This work is carried out with extensive collaboration with Maria Dainotti and several graduate and undergraduate students.

AI.abstract_translation: 源的形成率（FR）历史提供了关于宇宙如何从黑暗时代演变到现今阶段的关键信息。观测得最好的FR是恒星的形成率（SFR），它从高红移上升到红移3，然后下降至今天。活动星系核（AGNs）表现出相似的趋势，但参数不同。瞬变源如伽马射线暴（GRBs），以及在一定程度上快速射电暴（FRBs），凭借其大红移，是确定这一历史及其与SFR关系的良好候选者。方法：实现这一任务需要确定"光度函数"（LF）以及光度与FR的宇宙学演化。这通常是通过将数据正向拟合到某些假设的LF与演化的参数化形式来完成的，参数众多，且常常忽略光度演化。然而，近期的工作使用了由Lynden-Bell以及Efron和Petrosian（EP）发展的非参数化方法，该方法直接从"截断"数据中确定光度演化。在本次报告中，我将回顾使用这些方法对GRBs以及（若时间允许）FRBs的LF与FR演化的过去和更近期的估计。数据：这里的一个关键问题是需要有测得"流量"和红移（z）且截断由观测选择效应明确定义的样本，我们称之为"完备样本"。GRBs的主要来源一直是Neil Gehrels Swift天文台，另有一些数据来自Konus-Wind和Fermi-GBM。FRBs的主要来源一直是CHIME射电望远镜。一个主要的不确定性是红移测量所引入的选择效应。正如我将讨论的，使用机器学习（ML）来估计红移在这方面有所帮助。理论：对这些通常定位不佳的瞬变源而言，一个关键问题是它们的前身天体。GRBs被分为两类：长软暴和短硬暴。所谓的坍缩星（collapsars）被认为是GRBs的前身天体，而SGRBs的前身天体被认为是中子星（NS）-NS或NS-黑洞并合，后者也是引力波（GWs）和千新星（Kilonovae）的来源。FRBs也有两种类型："重复暴"和"非重复暴"，磁星（magnetars）是可能的前身天体。结果：GRBs一致地显示出（1）存在强的光度演化、一个分段的幂律LF以及多样的形成率演化。坍缩星作为短寿命恒星，预期会遵循SFR。我们发现LGRBs在高z处似乎遵循SFR，但在低z处作为一个随z降低而增大的低z成分而显著偏离SFR。SGRBs显示出一直增大到最低z的FR，类似于紧凑天体并合所预期的延迟SFR，也与LGRB的低z成分相似。这些发现对按持续时间来标准区分GRBs提出了质疑，并影响了所预期的GWs和千新星频率。FRBs也显示出光度演化和延迟的FR，支持其磁星起源。这项工作是与Maria Dainotti以及若干研究生和本科生的广泛合作中完成的。
AI.tldr: 该报告回顾了用非参数化方法估计GRBs（及若时间允许的FRBs）的光度函数与形成率演化，发现LGRBs在高z遵循SFR但在低z显著偏离，SGRBs呈延迟型形成率，并发现FRBs存在光度演化与延迟FR，支持磁星起源。
AI.motivation: 瞬变源（如GRBs，以及一定程度上FRBs）凭借其大红移，是确定源形成率（FR）历史及其与恒星形成率（SFR）关系的良好候选者，从而为理解宇宙从黑暗时代到现今的演化提供关键信息。
AI.method: 回顾运用Lynden-Bell以及Efron和Petrosian（EP）非参数化方法对GRBs（若时间允许也包括FRBs）的光度函数（LF）与形成率演化进行估计。数据来源为Neil Gehrels Swift天文台，以及Konus-Wind和Fermi-GBM的GRB数据，FRB数据来自CHIME。样本需为测得流量与红移且截断确定的"完备样本"，并讨论用机器学习（ML）估计红移以缓解选择效应。
AI.result: GRBs一致显示存在强的光度演化、分段幂律LF和多样的形成率演化。LGRBs在高z处似乎遵循SFR，但在低z处有一个随z降低而增大的成分并显著偏离SFR。SGRBs显示直到最低z都增大的FR，类似紧凑天体并合预期的延迟SFR，也与LGRB的低z成分相似。FRBs也显示光度演化和延迟的FR。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出这些发现对按持续时间标准区分GRBs（长软vs短硬）提出质疑，并影响所预期的引力波（GWs）与千新星频率。FRBs的光度演化与延迟FR支持其磁星起源。摘要无法判断这些结论对脉冲星观测的转移性。

title: Resurgence and hyperasymptotics in wave optics astronomy
summary: With the discovery of gravitational waves and fast radio bursts, wave optics has become increasingly relevant in astrophysics. This paper studies the behaviour of random gravitational and plasma lenses, presenting the refractive and diffractive expansions, with higher-order terms that allow error estimates and embody the counterintuitive resurgence phenomenon. Specifically, we show that the diffractive expansion converges for a broad class of bounded lens models and provides an efficient description of interference patterns across frequency regimes. Next, building on Picard-Lefschetz techniques, we derive the full refractive expansion, organising it into a transseries. Near caustics, the standard transseries is supplemented with uniform asymptotics. We study this transseries, with both Borel and hyperasymptotic resummation yielding systematic approximations to lensing integrals at all frequencies. Our results give a framework for modelling wave optics lensing near caustics and beyond the geometric optics approximation and thereby illustrate how tools from resurgence and asymptotic analysis can be applied to practical problems in astrophysics. Near caustic singularities, the post-refractive corrections diverge, while the uniform asymptotic expansion becomes accurate. We use the leading uniform approximation to bridge the singular caustic regime. For the Lorenzian lens, the leading-order diffractive-refractive-uniform expansions mosaic the full parameter space, providing quantitative switching criteria.
journal: Journal of Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics

AI.abstract_translation: 随着引力波和快速射电暴（FRB）的发现，波动光学在天体物理学中变得越来越重要。本文研究了随机引力和等离子体透镜的行为，给出了折射和衍射展开式及其高阶项，这些高阶项允许误差估计并体现了违反直觉的resurgence（复活）现象。具体而言，我们证明了衍射展开式对于一大类有界透镜模型是收敛的，并在各频率区间提供了对干涉图样的有效描述。接下来，基于Picard-Lefschetz技术，我们推导出完整的折射展开式，并将其整理为一个transseries（跨级数）。在焦散附近，标准transseries补充了均匀渐近形式。我们研究了这个transseries，其中Borel和hyperasymptotic（超渐近）重求和都能对透镜积分在各频率下给出系统的近似。我们的结果为在焦散附近以及超出几何光学近似范围之外的波动光学透镜建模提供了一个框架，从而说明resurgence和渐近分析的工具如何应用于天体物理学中的实际问题。在焦散奇点附近，折射后修正发散，而均匀渐近展开变得准确。我们使用领先阶均匀近似来衔接奇异的焦散区域。对于Lorenzian透镜，领先阶的衍射-折射-均匀展开拼接了完整的参数空间，提供了定量的切换判据。
AI.tldr: 本文为随机引力与等离子体透镜建立了一套完整的波动光学透镜数学框架：证明衍射展开对一类有界透镜收敛，并利用Borel和hyperasymptotic重求和将折射+衍射+均匀展开拼接成可覆盖全参数空间的完整体系，给出定量的切换判据。
AI.motivation: 随着引力波与快速射电暴（FRB）的发现，波动光学在天体物理中日益重要。现有几何光学近似在焦散附近失效，而透镜积分缺乏系统的、带误差估计的渐近框架，需要resurgence和渐近分析工具来弥合这一空白。
AI.method: 摘要未说明具体观测或数据。方法为理论推导：给出随机引力和等离子体透镜折射与衍射展开及高阶误差项；基于Picard-Lefschetz技术推导完整折射展开并组织为transseries；采用Borel与hyperasymptotic重求和；在焦散处补充均匀渐近展开并用领先阶均匀近似衔接奇异区。
AI.result: 衍射展开对一大类有界透镜模型收敛，能在各频率区间有效描述干涉图样；Borel与hyperasymptotic重求和均对各频率下透镜积分给出系统近似；近焦散处折射后修正发散而均匀渐近展开准确；对Lorenzian透镜，领先阶衍射-折射-均匀展开可拼接全参数空间并给出定量切换判据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为焦散附近及超出几何光学近似范围的波动光学透镜建模提供了统一框架，展示resurgence和渐近分析工具可应用于天体物理实际问题。摘要未涉及具体天体、脉冲星、磁星或FRB源观测的物理解释。根据摘要无法判断其与特定天体物理源的可转移性。

title: Constraining Scattering Medium Geometry with Cyclic Spectroscopy
summary: We use cyclic spectroscopy to infer the scintillation parameter C<SUB>1</SUB> for the millisecond pulsar B1937+21. This marks the first time this parameter has been measured for any pulsar without assuming a pulse broadening function shape prior to deconvolution from the intrinsic pulse profile, removing significant potential biases in scattering delay estimation and letting us consider a wider range of line-of-sight geometries. At 428 MHz, we find a weighted mean and standard deviation across multiple epochs and independent scintillation fluctuations of C<SUB>1</SUB> = 1.21 ± 0.01, which, along with the consistent presence of diffuse scintillation arcs, favors a thick-screen geometry spanning just over 10% of the Earth--pulsar distance. The resulting precision in our weighted average allows us to rule out various thin-screen geometries, as well as thick-screen geometries comprising more than 30% of the Earth--pulsar distance, with greater than 5σ certainty at this observing frequency. We also use our measured C<SUB>1</SUB> values to determine diffraction scales, which we find to be roughly 11 × 10<SUP>3</SUP> km between 418 and 438 MHz, suggesting an inner scale on the order of 10<SUP>3</SUP> km. Future implementations of our method to other lines of sight through the Galaxy may substantially improve efforts to understand structures that contribute to the majority of pulsar emission scattering in the interstellar medium. As flagship instruments like the Green Bank Telescope begin offering the use of cyclic spectroscopy backends, and other instruments begin exploration and commissioning of similar systems, demonstrations like these will be crucial for the widespread adoption of cyclic spectroscopy.

AI.abstract_translation: 我们利用循环谱学（cyclic spectroscopy）来推断毫秒脉冲星B1937+21的闪烁参数C<SUB>1</SUB>。这是该参数首次在未预先假定脉冲展宽函数（pulse broadening function）形状、未从固有脉冲轮廓解卷积的情况下被测量出，消除了散射时延估计中显著的系统性偏差来源，并使我们可以考虑更广泛的视线几何。在428 MHz下，我们在多个历元和独立的闪烁起伏中测得加权均值与标准差为C<SUB>1</SUB> = 1.21 ± 0.01，这与弥散闪烁弧的持续存在共同支持一种覆盖地球-脉冲星距离略超10%的厚屏几何。我们加权平均所达到的精度使我们能够以大于5σ的置信度在该观测频率下排除多种薄屏几何，以及覆盖地球-脉冲星距离30%以上的厚屏几何。我们还利用所测得的C<SUB>1</SUB>值来确定衍射尺度，在418至438 MHz之间我们测得该尺度约为11 × 10<SUP>3</SUP> km，这表明内尺度（inner scale）的数量级约为10<SUP>3</SUP> km。我们将该方法未来应用于穿过银河系的其它视线路径，可望实质性地增进对构成星际介质中绝大多数脉冲星发射散射的结构之理解。随着绿岸望远镜（Green Bank Telescope）等旗舰仪器开始提供使用循环谱学后端的服务，其它仪器也开始探索和调试类似系统，此类演示对于循环谱学的广泛采用将至关重要。
AI.tldr: 作者利用循环谱学在未预先假定脉冲展宽函数形状的情况下，首次测量了毫秒脉冲星B1937+21的闪烁参数C<SUB>1</SUB>，在428 MHz测得C<SUB>1</SUB> = 1.21 ± 0.01，支持覆盖地球-脉冲星距离约10%以上的厚屏几何，并测得其衍射尺度在418–438 MHz区间约为11 × 10<SUP>3</SUP> km。
AI.motivation: 以往测量散射延迟需预先假定脉冲展宽函数形状，可能带来显著偏差并限制视线几何的考虑范围。作者旨在通过循环谱学测量闪烁参数C<SUB>1</SUB>，无需预先假定的方式约束星际散射介质的几何结构（薄屏或厚屏）及其空间尺度。
AI.method: 摘要说明了观测对象为毫秒脉冲星B1937+21，但未说明具体望远镜和数据采用细节。方法上采用循环谱学推得闪烁参数C<SUB>1</SUB>，在428 MHz下于多个历元和独立闪烁起伏中做加权平均；利用C<SUB>1</SUB>值计算418–438 MHz间的衍射尺度，并借助弥散闪烁弧的观测对薄屏/厚屏几何加以约束。
AI.result: 在428 MHz测得加权均值与标准差为C<SUB>1</SUB> = 1.21 ± 0.01；该值连同持续存在的弥散闪烁弧，支持覆盖地球-脉冲星距离略超10%的厚屏几何。加权平均可在该频率下以大于5σ置信度排除多种薄屏几何及覆盖地球-脉冲星距离30%以上的厚屏几何。测得418–438 MHz间衍射尺度约11 × 10<SUP>3</SUP> km，暗示内尺度数量级约为10<SUP>3</SUP> km。
AI.conclusion: 作者推断B1937+21的视线星际散射介质更可能为覆盖地球-脉冲星距离约10%略多的厚屏几何，其内尺度量级约10<SUP>3</SUP> km。作者指出该方法推广到银河系其它视线路径可提升对星际介质中占主导的脉冲星发射散射结构的理解，并认为此类演示对循环谱学的广泛采用至关重要。根据摘要无法判断该方法对磁星或FRB研究的转移性。

title: EP251023a: A fast X-ray transient featuring a magnetar-powered optical internal plateau followed by a steep decay
summary: EP251023a is an extragalactic fast X-ray transient (eFXT) that was only detected by the Einstein Probe (EP) and that lacks a gamma-ray counterpart. The prompt emission consisted of a main emission with a duration T<SUB>90</SUB> = 292 ± 19 s, followed by a long-lasting tail emission that persisted until the observation ended at T<SUB>0</SUB> + 1571 s. With the upper limit of Konus--Wind, we derived a conservative upper limit on the isotropic gamma-ray energy E<SUB>γ,iso</SUB> of 5.7 × 10<SUP>52</SUP> erg for the main emission phase. We identified a redshift of z = 2.232 ± 0.001 based on the strong absorption features in the Keck spectrum, which also indicate a relatively low host-galaxy HI column density. Based on the broadband spectral energy distribution, the late-time light curves show an achromatic plateau, followed by an extremely steep decay with a slope of 3.99 after a break at about 49 ks. This is consistent with a rapidly spinning millisecond magnetar engine. Under the isotropic wind scenario, we obtained an initial period P<SUB>0</SUB> < 2.27 ms and a magnetic field strength B<SUB>p</SUB> < 8.33 × 10<SUP>14</SUP> G for the magnetar. If a jet collimation with a typical opening angle of 0.1 rad is considered, these constraints are relaxed to P<SUB>0</SUB> < 32.15 ms and B<SUB>p</SUB> < 1.18 × 10<SUP>16</SUP> G. Together with GRB 070707, EP251023a might represent a rare class of optical magnetar-powered internal plateaus with little external-shock contamination. This is different from previous examples that were primarily detected in X-rays. Future discoveries of similar events will help us to clarify the relation between magnetar-powered internal emission observed in the optical band and the emission that is only detected in X-rays.

AI.abstract_translation: EP251023a是一个河外快速X射线暂现源（eFXT），它仅被爱因斯坦探针（Einstein Probe，EP）探测到，并且缺乏伽马射线对应体。其瞬时辐射由一个持续时间为T<SUB>90</SUB> = 292 ± 19 s的主辐射组成，随后是一个长寿命的尾部辐射，一直持续到观测结束，即T<SUB>0</SUB> + 1571 s。利用Konus–Wind的上限，我们推导出主辐射阶段各向同性伽马射线能量E<SUB>γ,iso</SUB>的保守上限为5.7 × 10<SUP>52</SUP> erg。基于Keck光谱中的强吸收特征，我们确定了红移z = 2.232 ± 0.001，这些特征还表明宿主星系的中性氢柱密度相对较低。基于宽带光谱能量分布，晚期光变曲线呈现一个消色差的平台，随后在约49 ks处发生转折后呈现斜率为3.99的极陡衰减。这与一个快速自转的毫秒磁星引擎相一致。在各向同性风模型下，我们获得了磁星的初始周期P<SUB>0</SUB> < 2.27 ms和磁场强度B<SUB>p</SUB> < 8.33 × 10<SUP>14</SUP> G。如果考虑典型的0.1 rad开口角的喷流准直，这些约束放宽为P<SUB>0</SUB> < 32.15 ms和B<SUB>p</SUB> < 1.18 × 10<SUP>16</SUP> G。连同GRB 070707一起，EP251023a或许代表了一类罕见的光学磁星供能内部平台，其外部激波污染很小。这与以往主要在X射线中探测到的例子不同。未来对类似事件的发现将有助于我们厘清在光学波段观测到的磁星供能内部辐射与仅在X射线中探测到的辐射之间的关系。
AI.tldr: EP251023a是一个仅被爱因斯坦探针探测到的河外快速X射线暂现源，其晚期光变曲线呈现光学磁星供能的消色差内部平台及随后的陡衰减，约束出毫秒级初始周期和强磁场，并与GRB 070707一同可能代表一类罕见的光学磁星供能内部平台事件。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在探究EP251023a这一缺乏伽马射线对应体的河外快速X射线暂现源的物理本质，特别是判断其晚期的光学平台与陡衰减是否由自转毫秒磁星引擎驱动，并阐明与主要在X射线中探测到的磁星供能内部辐射之间的关系。
AI.method: 摘要说明了利用爱因斯坦探针（EP）观测、Konus–Wind上限、Keck光谱定红移以及宽带光谱能量分布对晚期光变曲线进行分析。研究给出了持续时间、红移、能量上限，并基于各向同性风模型及含0.1 rad开口角喷流准直的模型对磁星参数进行约束。
AI.result: EP251023a主辐射持续T<SUB>90</SUB>=292±19 s，尾部辐射持续至T<SUB>0</SUB>+1571 s；E<SUB>γ,iso</SUB>上限为5.7×10<SUP>52</SUP> erg；红移z=2.232±0.001。晚期光变曲线呈消色差平台，随后在约49 ks后以3.99的斜率极陡衰减。在各向同性风模型下P<SUB>0</SUB><2.27 ms、B<SUB>p</SUB><8.33×10<SUP>14</SUP> G；考虑0.1 rad准直后放宽为P<SUB>0</SUB><32.15 ms、B<SUB>p</SUB><1.18×10<SUP>16</SUP> G。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明EP251023a的晚期行为与高速自转的毫秒磁星引擎一致，其光学内部平台带有很少的外部激波污染，并与GRB 070707一道可能代表一类罕见的光学磁星供能内部平台事件，不同于以往主要在X射线中探测到的例子。根据摘要无法判断与脉冲星、磁星计时变速或FRB的直接联系。

title: A 20-Year X-ray Spectral Analysis of the Ultraluminous X-ray Pulsar NGC 5907 ULX-1
summary: XMM-Newton observations of NGC 5907 ULX-1 offer a unique opportunity to investigate the spectral evolution of a pulsating ultraluminous X-ray source over a long period with X-ray luminosities varying by up to one order of magnitude. NGC 5907 ULX-1 is the most luminous ultraluminous X-ray pulsar known to date and one of the ULX pulsars that exhibits spin-down during its low flux states. Benefiting from the long-term monitoring of the source between 2003-2024, we present the results of a systematic search for the best physically motivated model to fit the continuum of the X-ray spectrum with the help of different emission models and modeling procedures. Such an approach also serves to resolve degeneracies between thermal and non-thermal emission at low and high energies. As a natural outcome of our analysis, we study the correlation between the thermal and non-thermal model parameters such as the inner disk temperature, the photon index, and the electron temperature for Comptonization with respect to the spin observability and the X-ray luminosity of NGC 5907 ULX-1.

AI.abstract_translation: XMM-Newton对NGC 5907 ULX-1的观测提供了一个独特的机会，可以在较长时期内研究这一脉冲超亮X射线源的能谱演化，其X射线光度变化幅度可达一个数量级。NGC 5907 ULX-1是迄今已知最明亮的超亮X射线脉冲星，也是在其低流量状态下表现出自转减速的ULX脉冲星之一。得益于2003-2024年期间对该源的长周期监测，我们展示了利用不同的发射模型和建模流程，系统搜索最佳物理驱动模型以拟合X射线能谱连续谱的结果。这种方法也有助于解决在低能和高能下热与非热发射之间的简并。作为我们分析的自然结果，我们研究了热与非热模型参数（如内盘温度、光子指数以及康普顿化的电子温度）与NGC 5907 ULX-1的自转可观测性及X射线光度之间的相关性。
AI.tldr: 该论文利用XMM-Newton在2003-2024年期间的观测，系统搜索了能最好拟合超亮X射线脉冲星NGC 5907 ULX-1的X射线连续谱的最佳物理驱动模型，并研究了热与非热发射参数与自转可观测性及X射线光度之间的相关性。

title: Polarized X-Ray Emission from Accreting Millisecond Pulsars
summary: Millisecond pulsars (MSPs) are the quickest-spinning neutron stars (NSs) known. The X-ray pulsations produced by hot spots on their surface encode precious information on the mass and size of these compact objects; in this frame, accreting MSPs (AMSPs) are among the best targets because during X-ray outbursts they become relatively bright X-ray sources. Yet, breaking the degeneracy between the many parameters shaping their pulse profiles was not possible because of the limited effective area of X-ray instruments flown so far. X-ray polarimetry is a potential game-changer that provides an independent measure of the geometry of the hot spots. IXPE observed the outburst of SRGA J144459.2-604207 that occurred in February 2024 during a 10-day-long campaign also involving NICER, XMM-Newton, and NuSTAR. This observation provided the first detection of polarization in X-rays for an AMSP. The polarized signal showed a significantly energy-dependent polarization, and, thanks to an accurate pulse-timing solution, a phase-resolved polarimetric analysis was performed. Although the spin-phase variability of the normalized Stokes parameters is not highly significant, applying the relativistic rotating vector model, the hot spots' geometry was determined. The result indicates a moderately fan-beam emission from two point-like hot spots at a small magnetic obliquity. IXPE also detected 52 type-I X-ray bursts, which allowed for obtaining an upper limit on the polarization degree. In 2025, SAX J1808.4-3658 went into outburst, and IXPE observed it; preliminary analyses show a significant polarization also for this AMSP and the presence of a very bright type I X-ray burst in the light In this talk, the results obtained for the only two AMSP observed by IXPE so far are reported.

AI.abstract_translation: 毫秒脉冲星（MSPs）是已知旋转最快的致密星体（中子星，NSs）。其表面热斑产生的X射线脉冲含有关于这些致密天体质量与大小的珍贵信息；在此框架下，吸积毫秒脉冲星（AMSPs）是最佳目标之一，因为在X射线爆发期间它们会变成相对明亮的X射线源。然而，由于迄今已飞行的X射线仪器的有效面积有限，打破塑造其脉冲轮廓的众多参数之间的简并一直无法实现。X射线偏振测量是一个潜在的变革性手段，它为热斑的几何结构提供了一种独立的测量。IXPE观测了SRGA J144459.2-604207于2024年2月发生的爆发，观测活动为期10天，同时还包括NICER、XMM-Newton和NuSTAR。这次观测提供了AMSP在X射线波段偏振的首次探测。偏振信号显示出显著的能量相关偏振，并且，得益于精确的脉冲计时（pulse-timing）方案，完成了相位分辨（phase-resolved）偏振分析。尽管归一化Stokes参数的旋转相位变化并非高度显著，但通过应用相对论旋转矢量模型（relativistic rotating vector model），确定了热斑的几何结构。该结果表明，在较小磁倾角下，来自两个点状热斑的发射为中等程度的扇形束（fan-beam）发射。IXPE还探测到52次I型X射线暴，从而使获得偏振度上限成为可能。2025年，SAX J1808.4-3658进入爆发，IXPE对其进行了观测；初步分析显示该AMSP也存在显著的偏振，并且在光变中还存在一次非常明亮的I型X射线暴。在本次报告中，将介绍IXPE迄今观测到的仅有两颗AMSP所获得的结果。
AI.tldr: IXPE对吸积毫秒脉冲星SRGA J144459.2-604207爆发期的观测实现了AMSP在X射线波段的首次偏振探测，并借助相对论旋转矢量模型确定热斑几何为小磁倾角下的中等扇形束发射。
AI.motivation: 毫秒脉冲星表面热斑产生的X射线脉冲编码了关于致密天体质量与尺寸的信息，但受限于已飞X射线仪器的有效面积，无法打破塑造脉冲轮廓的众多参数间的简并；X射线偏振测量有望独立测定热斑几何结构。
AI.method: 摘要未说明观测频率或时间跨度细节，但明确为IXPE对SRGA J144459.2-604207于2024年2月爆发的为期10天的观测活动，同时涉及NICER、XMM-Newton和NuSTAR；借助精确脉冲计时方案进行相位分辨偏振分析，并应用相对论旋转矢量模型；2025年对SAX J1808.4-3658爆发进行IXPE观测。
AI.result: 对SRGA J144459.2-604207实现了AMSP在X射线波段的首次偏振探测，偏振信号具有显著的能量相关偏振；归一化Stokes参数的旋转相位变化并非高度显著；模型结果显示来自两个点状热斑的发射为中等程度扇形束，磁倾角较小；IXPE探测到52次I型X射线暴并获得偏振度上限；SAX J1808.4-3658的初步分析显示显著偏振并存在一次非常明亮的I型X射线暴。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出，通过相对论旋转矢量模型，可由偏振数据确定AMSP热斑的几何结构（两个点状热斑、小磁倾角、中等扇形束发射），表明X射线偏振测量在测定吸积毫秒脉冲星热斑几何方面具有变革性价值。根据摘要无法判断这些结果与磁星或FRB的直接联系。

title: Exploring X-ray reprocessing in 4U 1626─67 through QPO-Phase Resolved Analysis
summary: 4U 1626─67 is a benchmark system for understanding complex accretion physics in ultracompact low-mass X-ray binaries (LMXBs). A defining characteristic of this LMXB hosting an accreting neutron star is the presence of a stable ∼48 mHz Quasi-Periodic Oscillation (QPO), exhibited exclusively during the spin-down torque state of the pulsar. We present a comprehensive QPO-phase-resolved study of the source using archival XMM-Newton observations to probe its accretion dynamics. We employed Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) to isolate the QPO signal and extract its instantaneous phase. By resolving the 0.5─10 keV pulse profile morphology over the QPO cycle, we observe a significant evolution in the beaming pattern. This timing analysis is integrated with phase-resolved spectroscopy using simultaneous EPIC-PN and RGS data. We find that the spectral parameters exhibit strong variability with the QPO phase, pointing towards a dynamic X-ray reprocessing scenario. We discuss these findings from the perspective of the neutron star beaming geometry and inner accretion disk structure in 4U 1626─67.

AI.abstract_translation: 4U 1626─67 是理解超致密低质量X射线双星（LMXBs）中复杂吸积物理的基准系统。该容纳着吸积中子星的LMXB的一个典型特征是存在稳定的约48 mHz准周期振荡（QPO），且该振荡仅在脉冲星的自旋减速扭矩状态下显现。我们利用存档的XMM-Newton观测对源进行了一项全面的QPO相位分辨研究，以探测其吸积动力学。我们采用变分模态分解（VMD）来分离QPO信号并提取其瞬时相位。通过在QPO周期内对0.5─10 keV脉冲轮廓形态进行分辨，我们观察到波束模式存在显著演化。该计时分析被与使用同步EPIC-PN和RGS数据的相位分辨光谱学相结合。我们发现光谱参数随QPO相位表现出强烈变化，指向一种动态的X射线再处理情景。我们从中子星波束几何和4U 1626─67内吸积盘结构的角度讨论了这些发现。
AI.tldr: 4U 1626─67的QPO相位分辨研究表明，该超致密LMXB中约48 mHz QPO周期内的脉冲轮廓形态与光谱参数均随QPO相位显著变化，指向动态的X射线再处理情景。
AI.motivation: 该研究以超致密低质量X射线双星4U 1626─67为基准系统，旨在通过QPO相位分辨分析理解其复杂吸积物理，尤其是存在于自旋减速状态下的约48 mHz QPO所反映的中子星波束几何与内吸积盘结构。
AI.method: 利用存档的XMM-Newton观测进行QPO相位分辨研究；采用变分模态分解（VMD）分离QPO信号并提取瞬时相位；在0.5─10 keV能段对QPO周期内的脉冲轮廓形态进行分辨；并结合使用同步EPIC-PN和RGS数据的相位分辨光谱学与计时分析。
AI.result: 研究发现，在QPO周期内0.5─10 keV脉冲轮廓观察到波束模式的显著演化；同时光谱参数随QPO相位表现出强烈变化，指向动态的X射线再处理情景。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出脉冲轮廓的演化与光谱参数的QPO相位依赖表明存在动态X射线再处理情景，并从该源的吸积中子星波束几何与内吸积盘结构角度加以讨论。该研究未涉及脉冲星、磁星或FRB等主题，相关判断在此不作推断。

title: A double-photospheric radius-expansion thermonuclear X-ray burst
summary: Intermittent unstable thermonuclear burning of accreted matter on neutron stars gives rise to thermonuclear (type-I) X-ray bursts. Such bursts provide a testbed to study nuclear fusion processes in intense radiation, gravity, and magnetic fields. The strongest ones among such bursts temporarily push the photosphere away from the stellar surface, and are known as photospheric radius-expansion bursts. Although several thousand bursts have been detected over the past decades, here we report the first observation of a single burst with two consecutive photospheric radius-expansion events. This burst was found from the AstroSat observation of the accretion-powered millisecond X-ray pulsar IGR J17591-2342. Our basic spectral model for the burst includes an absorbed blackbody to describe the burst emission and an absorbed power law to represent the non-burst emission. The blackbody normalisation shows two consecutive humps aligned with blackbody temperature dips during the burst. Such an unusual behaviour could imply two consecutive photospheric radius-expansion events during the same burst or a systematic metallicity evolution in the neutron star atmosphere. However, our spectral analysis suggests the latter option is less likely to be happening for IGR J17591-2342. This result challenges current theoretical understanding. [A A, 701, A54 (2025)].

AI.abstract_translation: 中子星上吸积物质的间歇性不稳定热核燃烧会产生热核（I型）X射线暴。这类暴发为研究强辐射、强引力和强磁场环境下的核聚变过程提供了一个试验平台。此类暴发中最强的事件会暂时将光球推离恒星表面，被称为光球半径膨胀暴。尽管在过去数十年间已经探测到数千次暴发，但我们在此报告首次观测到单次暴发中出现两次连续的光球半径膨胀事件。该暴发是在对吸积驱动的毫秒X射线脉冲星IGR J17591-2342的AstroSat观测中发现的。我们用于该暴发的基谱法模型包含一个被吸收的黑体分量来描述暴发射，以及一个被吸收的幂律分量代表非暴发射。黑体归一化在暴发期间显示出两次连续的高峰，并与黑体温度下降的时刻对齐。这种不寻常的行为可能意味着在同一次暴发中发生了两次连续的光球半径膨胀事件，或者中子星大气中存在系统性的金属丰度演化。然而，我们的光谱分析表明对于IGR J17591-2342而言，后一种可能性不太可能发生。这一结果对当前的理论认识提出了挑战。[A A, 701, A54 (2025)]。
AI.tldr: 在AstroSat对吸积驱动毫秒X射线脉冲星IGR J17591-2342的观测中，首次发现单次热核X射线暴包含两次连续的光球半径膨胀事件，黑体归一化出现与温度下降对齐的两次连续高峰；光谱分析认为中子星大气金属丰度演化的解释不太可能，这一结果挑战了当前理论认识。
AI.motivation: 热核（I型）X射线暴可作为强辐射、强引力、强磁场环境下核聚变过程的研究平台，其中最强的暴（光球半径膨胀暴）会将光球推离恒星表面。尽管已探测到数千次暴发，此前从未观察到单次暴发中出现两次连续的光球半径膨胀事件，这一现象成为本文研究的问题与知识空白。
AI.method: 对吸积驱动的毫秒X射线脉冲星IGR J17591-2342进行AstroSat观测。光谱模型包含一个被吸收的黑体分量描述暴发射，以及一个被吸收的幂律分量代表非暴发射，并分析黑体归一化与黑体温度的演化行为。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、样品数量与统计方法。
AI.result: 首次在单次暴发中观测到两次连续的光球半径膨胀事件。黑体归一化在暴发期间显示两次连续的高峰，并与黑体温度下降的时刻对齐。这种不寻常行为可能表示同一次暴中的两次连续光球半径膨胀事件，或中子星大气的系统性金属丰度演化；但光谱分析表明金属丰度演化这一解释对IGR J17591-2342不太可能发生。
AI.conclusion: 作者将观测到的行为解释为单次热核X射线暴中出现两次连续的光球半径膨胀事件，并认为针对IGR J17591-2342的系统性金属丰度演化解释不太可能成立；由于该现象为首次观测且与单纯成分演化预测不符，结果对当前理论理解提出挑战。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星模式转换或FRB现象有何关联。

title: Close binary systems: evolution and environment
summary: Binary stars are very important in Astronomy. In some cases, it is possible to access, with good precision, the fundamental parameter that determines the evolution of an isolated star: its mass. In close binary systems, if close enough to each other, the evolution of the components changes completely compared to what each of them would have had in isolation, because mass loss may occur by Roche lobe overflow. Examples of objects due to binary evolution are low-mass helium white dwarfs, type Ia supernova progenitors, cataclysmic variables, black widows and redbacks families, blue and yellow stragglers. In addition to the two stellar components, there is another fundamental actor: the accretion disk. Accretion disks have been studied for decades. However, the complexity of the physical processes that occur in it means that we still have a lot to explore. In this poster, we will make a brief description of the evolution of close binary systems composed of a low-mass normal star and a neutron star, using models obtained from our binary evolution code. We show the method we use to search for a possible progenitor of PSR J1622-0315, a redback whose characteristic parameters have been recently determined. Subsequently, we describe the thin disk treatment (``alpha disk''), where it is possible to decouple the vertical from the radial treatment (where temporal evolution is found). We present our first results and discuss the steps to follow to study the effect of neutron star irradiation on the accretion disk.
journal: Revista Mexicana de Astronomia y Astrofisica Conference Series

AI.abstract_translation: 双星在天文学中非常重要。在某些情况下，我们能够以很高的精度获得决定孤立恒星演化的基本参数：其质量。在密近双星系统中，如果两颗星彼此足够接近，那么各组分的演化方式就会与它们在孤立状态下的演化完全不同，因为通过洛希瓣溢流（Roche lobe overflow）可能会发生质量损失。由双星演化产生的天体实例包括低质量氦白矮星、Ia型超新星前身星、激变变星（cataclysmic variables）、黑寡妇（black widows）和红背（redbacks）族、蓝离散星和黄离散星。除两颗恒星组分外，还有另一个基本角色：吸积盘。吸积盘已被研究了数十年。然而，其中发生的物理过程的复杂性意味着我们仍有很多有待探索之处。在本海报中，我们将利用由我们的双星演化代码所获得的模型，简要描述由一颗低质量普通星和一颗中子星组成的密近双星系统的演化。我们展示了用于搜寻PSR J1622-0315的可能前身星的方法，这是一颗其特征参数近期已被确定下来的红背天体。随后，我们描述薄盘处理（“alpha盘”），在该处理中可以将垂直方向的处理与径向的处理（其中可以确定时间演化）解耦。我们展示首批结果，并讨论为研究中子星辐照对吸积盘的影响而采取的后续步骤。
AI.tldr: 本文用双星演化代码建模了一颗低质量普通星与一颗中子星组成的密近双星系统的演化，用以搜寻红背天体PSR J1622-0315的可能前身星，并介绍了吸积盘的薄盘（"alpha盘"）处理方法及首批结果。
AI.motivation: 密近双星中各组分的演化会因洛希瓣溢流的质量损失而完全不同于孤立演化，形成白矮星、超新星前身星、红背族等天体；吸积盘内物理过程复杂且仍有很多待探索之处。作者由此展开对含中子星的密近双星演化的研究与后续展望。
AI.method: 摘要说明：利用作者开发的二元演化代码建立的模型，简要描述由低质量普通星和中子星组成的密近双星系统的演化；展示搜寻PSR J1622-0315（特征参数近期确定的红背天体）可能前身星的搜寻方法；描述薄盘（"alpha盘"）处理方法，其中可将垂直方向处理与含时间演化的径向处理解耦。具体观测数据、时段等摘要未说明。
AI.result: 摘要说明：作者展示了其搜寻PSR J1622-0315可能前身星的方法，介绍了可解耦垂直与径向处理的薄盘（"alpha盘"）处理方式，并展示了首批结果。具体数值、显著性等摘要未说明。

title: The Crab pulsar puzzle: Observing and understanding its striped radio spectra
summary: A theory of the puzzling spectral "zebra" pattern of the Crab pulsar's high-frequency interpulse (HFIP) is developed. Thus, it solves a nearly 20-year-old mystery of the Crab pulsar radio emission. The observed emission bands are the high-contrast interference maxima, resulting from the combined effects of gravitational lensing and plasma de-lensing, and produced by multiple ray propagating through the pulsar magnetosphere. The model enables space-resolved tomography (like a CT scan) of the pulsar magnetosphere, yielding a plasma profile of n_e∝ 1/r^3, which agrees with theoretical insights. The model essentially resolves a 10-100-km scale at a distance of 2kpc — nearly million times better than EHT, which observed a galactic black hole. We predict the zebra pattern trend to change at a higher frequency when the ray separation becomes smaller than the pulsar size. This frequency is predicted to be in the range between 42 GHz and 650 GHz, which is within the reach of existing facilities like ALMA and SMA. These observations would advance our understanding of the magnetosphere and potentially explore gravity in the strong field regime near the star's surface. — The author acknowledges support by the National Science Foundation (NSF) under grant PHY-2409249. This research was supported in part by grant NSF PHY-2309135 to the Kavli Institute for Theoretical Physics (KITP).

AI.abstract_translation: 本文发展了关于蟹状星云脉冲星高频中间脉冲（HFIP）令人费解的光谱“斑马”图案的理论。因此，它解决了一个近20年之久的蟹状星云脉冲星射电发射之谜。观测到的发射带是高对比度的干涉极大值，由引力透镜和等离子体去透镜的共同效应产生，并由穿过脉冲星磁层的多条射线产生。该模型能够实现脉冲星磁层的空间分辨断层成像（如同CT扫描），给出与理论见解相符的n_e∝ 1/r^3等离子体剖面。该模型在2 kpc距离上基本分辨出10–100 km的尺度——比观测了银河系黑洞的EHT好近一百万倍。我们预测，当射线间距变得小于脉冲星大小时，斑马图案趋势会在更高频率发生变化。该频率被预测在42 GHz至650 GHz之间，处于ALMA和SMA等现有设施可及的范围内。这些观测将推进我们对磁层的理解，并有可能在恒星表面附近的强场区探索引力。——作者感谢国家科学基金会（NSF）在拨款PHY-2409249下的支持。这项研究部分得到加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校卡弗里理论物理研究所（KITP）的NSF PHY-2309135拨款支持。
AI.tldr: 本文建立了蟹状星云脉冲星高频中间脉冲（HFIP）光谱“斑马”图案的理论，将其解释为由引力透镜与等离子体去透镜共同作用、多射线干涉产生的高对比度极大值，并由此得出磁层等离子体剖面n_e∝ 1/r^3，同时预测该图案在42–650 GHz频率范围内会发生改变。
AI.motivation: 蟹状星云脉冲星高频中间脉冲（HFIP）的“斑马”光谱图案近20年来一直缺乏理论解释，构成该脉冲星射电发射之谜的核心科学空白。本文旨在建立理论模型以阐明这一发射带结构，并利用其对脉冲星磁层进行空间分辨成像，以深化对磁层及恒星表面附近强场引力物理的理解。
AI.method: 摘要说明了理论方法的开发及其观测预测，但未明确介绍具体观测、数据、望远镜或时间跨度。方法细节包括：基于引力透镜与等离子体去透镜以及多射线传播建立模型，实现磁层空间分辨断层成像（类CT扫描），并给出等离子体剖面n_e∝ 1/r^3；预测磁层分辨尺度及图案变化频率范围42 GHz至650 GHz（摘要未说明具体观测数据的采用）。
AI.result: 观测到的发射带被解释为引力透镜与等离子体去透镜共同作用、多射线干涉产生的高对比度极大值。该模型在2 kpc距离上基本分辨出10–100 km尺度，据称比观测银河系黑洞的EHT好近一百万倍。模型得到与理论一致的n_e∝ 1/r^3等离子体剖面，并预测斑马图案趋势随射线间距小于脉冲星尺寸而在42 GHz至650 GHz的频率范围内发生变化。

title: X-ray Polarimetry: A Newly Available Window in Astrophysics
summary: At the beginning of X-ray astronomy, it was predicted that polarimetry would play a major diagnostic role in this field. Early polarimetry experiments followed the first advances of X-ray astronomy by only a few years. However, when Riccardo Giacconi revolutionized the field with focusing X-ray optics, polarimetry, whose sensitivity was far inferior, was set aside for many decades. The situation changed dramatically with the invention of detectors based on the photoelectric effect in gas. The Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer, based on this technique, has extended to polarimetry the breakthrough in sensitivity achieved in imaging X-ray astronomy with the Einstein Observatory. Launched on 9 December 2021, IXPE has so far observed more than 100 sources across all major source classes and detected significant polarization in nearly 80% of them. In many cases, IXPE results have challenged several established views in relativistic astrophysics, expanding our understanding of how the Universe works. The mission has shed light on particle acceleration in pulsar wind nebulae, supernova remnants, and blazars; on scattering processes in molecular clouds around the Galactic Center, in black-hole binaries, radio-quiet active galactic nuclei, and in weakly magnetized neutron-star binaries; on strong-gravity effects also in black-hole binaries; and on the transport of radiation in highly magnetized plasma at the poles of neutron stars, as well as in the extreme magnetospheres of magnetars. In this talk I will review the main scientific results obtained so far with IXPE and discuss possible paths to extend these achievements through future X-ray polarimetry missions in upcoming opportunities.

AI.abstract_translation: 在X射线天文学起步之初，人们就预言偏振测量（polarimetry）将在这个领域中发挥重要的诊断作用。早期的偏振测量实验紧随着X射线天文学最初的进展仅数年便开展。然而，当Riccardo Giacconi以聚焦X射线光学器件革新了这一领域时，灵敏度远为逊色的偏振测量被搁置了数十年。随着基于气体中光电效应的探测器被发明，情况发生了显著变化。基于这一技术的成像X射线偏振探测器（Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer，IXPE），已将在成像X射线天文学中借助爱因斯坦天文台（Einstein Observatory）所实现的灵敏度突破延伸到了偏振测量领域。IXPE于2021年12月9日发射，迄今已观测了所有主要源类型中超过100个源，并在其中近80%的源中探测到了显著的偏振。在许多情况下，IXPE的结果挑战了相对论天体物理学中若干既有的认知，拓展了我们对宇宙运行方式的理解。该任务揭示了脉冲星风云、超新星遗迹和耀变体（blazar）中的粒子加速过程；揭示了银河系中心周围分子云、黑洞双星、射电宁静活动星系核以及弱磁场中子星双星中的散射过程；揭示了黑洞双星中强引力效应；还揭示了中子星两极高度磁化等离子体中以及磁星的极端磁层中的辐射输运过程。在本次报告中，我将回顾利用IXPE迄今取得的主要科学结果，并讨论在未来的机遇中，通过未来的X射线偏振测量任务将这些成果加以拓展的可能途径。
AI.tldr: 基于气体光电效应技术的IXPE任务将X射线偏振测量的灵敏度突破推向了成像天文学的水平，自2021年12月9日发射以来已观测超过100个源，并在近80%中探测到显著偏振，其挑战并拓展了对脉冲星风云、超新星遗迹、耀变体、黑洞双星及磁星等天体中若干主流物理过程的理解。
AI.motivation: X射线偏振测量自X射线天文学初期即被预言具有重要诊断作用，但因灵敏度不足被搁置数十年；本报告旨在回顾IXPE任务目前取得的主要科学成果，并讨论拓展这些成果的未来X射线偏振测量任务的可能路径。
AI.method: 摘要未说明特定的具体观测数据与分析方法细节。文中明确介绍采用基于气体光电效应的探测器技术，以及IXPE（成像X射线偏振探测器，Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer）任务，该任务于2021年12月9日发射，截至总结时已观测所有主要源类型中超过100个源。摘要说明IXPE将爱因斯坦天文台（Einstein Observatory）实现的成像灵敏度突破延伸至偏振测量领域。
AI.result: IXPE已观测所有主要源类型中超过100个源，并在其中近80%的源中探测到了显著偏振。其结果挑战了相对论天体物理学中若干既有认知，涉及：脉冲星风云、超新星遗迹和耀变体中的粒子加速；银河系中心周围分子云、黑洞双星、射电宁静活动星系核及弱磁场中子星双星中的散射过程；黑洞双星中的强引力效应；以及中子星两极和磁星极端磁层中的辐射输运。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为IXPE的结果已在多个方面挑战并拓展了对宇宙运行方式的理解，涵盖粒子加速、散射、强引力以及磁化等离子体中辐射输运等过程。摘要属于对未来探测路径的讨论。据此无法判断报告结论是否可直接或具体迁移至脉冲星、磁星、FRB等观测主题之外的定量研判；其涉及脉冲星风云与磁星的部分仅作为IXPE成果内容被陈述，根据摘要无法判断。

title: Consequences of the presence of extended disks and shells around magnetars
summary: The presence of disks and shells around magnetars is predicted to limit the propagation of high-energy electrons and positrons, which influence observations of galactic cosmic rays in the inner heliosphere. On the other hand, both the presence of precessing disks and precessing magnetars have been invoked to explain the modulation of X-rays by several magnetars. Magnetar ellipticities are key parameters that could distinguish the role of these precessing compact objects from that of precessing disks. The lack of observations of gravitational waves from magnetars, such as pulsars, is another important piece of the puzzle. Inferences on magnetar parameters in the literature will be compared, and a coherent scenario will be presented at the conference.

AI.abstract_translation: 磁星周围圆盘和壳层结构的存在预计会限制高能电子和正电子的传播，而这些高能电子和正电子会影响内日球层中银河宇宙射线的观测。另一方面，进动圆盘和进动磁星的存在都已被用来解释多个磁星的X射线调制现象。磁星的椭率是关键参数，可以区分这些进动致密天体与进动圆盘各自所起的作用。缺乏来自磁星（如脉冲星）的引力波观测，是这一谜题中的另一个重要组成部分。文献中对磁星参数的推断将被比较，并在会议[报道]中展示一个连贯的情景。
AI.tldr: 本文旨在围绕磁星限制高能电子与正电子传播、进动圆盘与进动磁星调制X射线，以及磁星引力波观测缺失等观测证据，比较文献中对磁星参数的推断，提出一个连贯的物理情景。
AI.motivation: 磁星周围的圆盘和壳层结构可能影响高能电子和正电子的传播，从而影响内日球层的银河宇宙射线观测；同时进动圆盘与进动磁星都被用来解释多个磁星的X射线调制，需通过磁星椭率等参数加以区分，并结合引力波观测缺失来理解相关观测现象。
AI.method: 摘要未说明具体观测或分析方法。
AI.result: 摘要报告了若干被提出的观测情形：磁星周围的圆盘和壳层会限制高能电子与正电子的传播并影响银河宇宙射线观测；进动圆盘和进动磁星均被用来解释多个磁星的X射线调制；磁星椭率被视为区分两种进动来源的关键参数；目前缺乏来自磁星（如脉冲星）的引力波观测。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出将对文献中磁星参数的推断进行比较，并在会议上展示一个连贯的情景；该结论尚属会议中的陈述计划，未给出已确立的物理结果。根据摘要无法判断。

title: The role of the Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor in the era of big-data astronomy
summary: The Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor (GBM) detects on average 240 gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) per year, providing the most comprehensive all-sky view of the transient gamma-ray sky. GBM detected the first—and so far only—short-GRB counterpart to a binary neutron star merger observed via gravitational waves (GWs), a discovery that connected relativistic jets, nucleosynthesis, and multi-messenger astrophysics, and helped define the science landscape for future missions. Following the completion of the fourth observing run (O4) of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration (LVK), no additional joint GRB─GW detections have yet been confirmed. Throughout O4, the Fermi-GBM team conducted real-time searches for coincident gamma-ray emission from all public GW events using on-board triggers as well as two complementary sub-threshold pipelines: the Targeted and Untargeted Searches. These analyses allow GBM to place stringent upper limits on prompt gamma-ray emission and produce joint upper-limit skymaps. With its large field of view and continuous monitoring, GBM remains a cornerstone instrument in the era of data-intensive time-domain astronomy, capable of detecting counterparts—or setting meaningful limits—for a wide range of transient phenomena. I will present our follow-up efforts and highlight key GBM results, from fast radio bursts to long-duration gamma-ray counterparts from compact mergers.

AI.abstract_translation: 费米伽马暴监视器（GBM）平均每年探测到240个伽马暴（GRB），提供了瞬变伽马射线全天最全面的观测视角。GBM探测到了第一个——也是迄今为止唯一一个——通过引力波观测到的双中子星并合所对应的短暴（short-GRB）对应体，这一发现将相对论性喷流、核合成与多信使天体物理学联系起来，并帮助界定了未来任务的科学图景。继LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组织（LVK）第四次观测运行（O4）完成之后，尚无额外的联合GRB─GW探测得到确认。在整个O4期间，Fermi-GBM团队利用星上触发以及两个互补的亚阈值管线——定向搜索（Targeted Search）与非定向搜索（Untargeted Search）——对所有公开的引力波事件开展了瞬变伽马射线辐射的实时搜索。这些分析使GBM能够对瞬时伽马发射给出严格的流量上限，并生成联合上限全天图。凭借其大视场和连续监测能力，GBM在数据密集型时域天文学时代仍然是基石级仪器，能够为广泛的瞬变现象探测对应体——或设定有意义的限制。我将介绍我们的后续跟踪工作，并突出展示GBM的关键结果，从快速射电暴到致密天体并合的长时标伽马对应体。
AI.tldr: 费米GBM在O4运行期间对引力波事件开展了实时伽马辐射搜索并给出严格上限；该论文强调GBM作为基石仪器可探测或约束广泛的瞬变现象，其覆盖范围从快速射电暴到长时标伽马对应体。
AI.motivation: 摘要的动机在于说明费米GBM在大数据天文学时代的作用，特别是O4运行结束后仍无额外联合GRB-GW探测被确认，需要评估GBM在探测对应体或设置上限方面对多种瞬变现象（含FRB与致密天体并合长时标伽马对应体）的能力。
AI.method: 摘要说明GBM平均每年探测240个GRB。团队在O4期间对所有公开GW事件进行实时巧合伽马发射搜索，采用星上触发以及两个互补的亚阈值管线：定向搜索与非定向搜索，并据此生成联合上限全天图。
AI.result: 摘要报道GBM探测了第一个且迄今唯一的短GRB-GW对应体（双中子星并合的短暴）；O4结束后尚无额外联合GRB-GW探测得到确认。分析使GBM能对瞬时伽马辐射设置严格上限并生成联合上限全天图。
AI.conclusion: 摘要的结论认为，凭借大视场与连续监测，GBM仍是数据密集型时域天文学时代的基石仪器，可对广泛的瞬变现象探测对应体或设定有意义的限制；其覆盖从快速射电暴到致密天体并合的长时标伽马对应体。根据摘要无法判断对磁星研究的具体含义。

title: Relativistic Monte Carlo modeling of cyclotron lines in subcritical X-ray pulsars
summary: Numerical and analytical calculations are powerful tools for studying the accretion dynamics of X-ray pulsars (XRPs), yet translating their results into quantitative spectral predictions remains difficult. Consequently, dedicated radiative transfer simulations are essential for probing the physics near the neutron star surface and interpreting observational data. In this work, we present a fully relativistic Monte Carlo radiative transfer code developed to investigate the origin of Cyclotron Resonant Scattering Features (CRSFs). To model the accretion environment, we adopted the analytical plasma-density and velocity profiles of Mushtukov et al. (2015), which account for the effects of radiation pressure on the flow. To ensure accuracy in regions of rapid density variation, we implemented an adaptive step-size algorithm. Particular care was given to the boundary treatment at the base of the scattering region (the hot spot). We examined two scenarios for photon-surface interactions: (1) Geometric Reflection, where photons are reflected elastically, preserving their energy; and (2) Thermalization, where photons are instantaneously absorbed and re-emitted, with their energies resampled from the blackbody distribution and directions randomized. We generate angle-resolved spectra across a range of X-ray luminosities to examine the impact of luminosity and viewing angle θ (with respect to the magnetic field). Our results successfully reproduce the observed correlations between the luminosity and the CRSF centroid energy E_CRSF and line width σ_CRSF: both quantities correlate positively with luminosity. Furthermore, they exhibit strong variability over the pulse phase, with E_CRSF scaling negatively with cosθ and σ_CRSF positively. Finally, we validate our framework against the XRP GX 304-1. Our model successfully reproduces the observed spectral variability over an order of magnitude in luminosity, consistent with an edge-on viewing geometry. Looking ahead, extending this framework to include polarization-dependent scattering will yield testable predictions for the new generation of X-ray polarimetry missions.

AI.abstract_translation: 数值与解析计算是研究X射线脉冲星（XRPs）吸积动力学的强大工具，但将其结果转化为定量的谱预测仍然困难。因此，专门的辐射转移模拟对于探测中子星表面附近的物理并解释观测数据至关重要。在本工作中，我们提出了一套完全相对论的蒙特卡罗辐射转移代码，用于研究回旋共振散射特征（CRSFs）的起源。为模拟吸积环境，我们采用了Mushtukov等人（2015）的解析等离子体密度与速度剖面，该剖面考虑了辐射压力对流动的影响。为确保密度快速变化区域的准确性，我们实现了一种自适应步长算法。对散射区域基底部（热点）的边界处理给予了特别关注。我们考察了光子与表面相互作用的两种情形：（1）几何反射（Geometric Reflection），即光子被弹性反射，保持其能量；以及（2）热化（Thermalization），即光子被瞬时吸收并重新发射，其能量从黑体分布中重新采样，方向被随机化。我们在一定范围的X射线光度上生成角分辨谱，以考察光度和观测角θ（相对于磁场）的影响。我们的结果成功地再现了光度与CRSF质心能量E_CRSF及线宽σ_CRSF之间观测到的相关性：这两个量均与光度正相关。此外，它们在脉冲相位上表现出强烈的变化，其中E_CRSF随cosθ呈负相关变化，σ_CRSF随cosθ呈正相关变化。最后，我们针对X射线脉冲星GX 304-1验证了我们的框架。我们的模型成功地再现了在一个数量级光度范围内观测到的谱变化，这与侧向（edge-on）观测几何一致。展望未来，将该框架扩展以包含偏振相关的散射，将为新一代X射线偏振测量任务提供可检验的预言。
AI.tldr: 本文提出一套完全相对论蒙特卡罗辐射转移代码，研究亚临界X射线脉冲星中回旋共振散射特征（CRSFs）的起源，并成功再现E_CRSF与σ_CRSF随光度及视角余弦的正/负相关关系，以及对XRP GX 304-1的观测验证。
AI.motivation: 数值与解析计算虽能研究X射线脉冲星的吸积动力学，但难以转化为定量谱预言，因此需专门的辐射转移模拟来探测中子星表面附近的物理并解释观测数据，特别是探究回旋共振散射特征（CRSFs）的起源。
AI.method: 采用完全相对论的蒙特卡罗辐射转移代码；采用Mushtukov等人（2015）的解析等离子体密度与速度剖面；实现自适应步长算法；在散射区域基底部（热点）进行特殊边界处理；考察光子-表面相互作用的几何反射与热化两种情形；在一定范围X射线光度下生成角分辨谱，考察光度与观测角θ的影响。
AI.result: 结果成功再现光度与CRSF质心能量E_CRSF及线宽σ_CRSF之间的观测相关性，两者均与光度正相关；二者在脉冲相位上表现出强烈变化，E_CRSF随cosθ负相关、σ_CRSF随cosθ正相关；针对XRP GX 304-1，模型在约一个数量级的光度范围内成功再现观测谱变化，与侧向（edge-on）观测几何一致。
AI.conclusion: 作者支持的物理结论是：所发展的相对论蒙特卡罗辐射转移框架能定量再现CRSF能量与线宽随光度、视角及脉冲相位的变化，且对GX 304-1的验证支持侧向观测几何。对X射线偏振测量、辐射转移等方法的扩展被认为可提供可检验预言，但摘要未直接将其联系到脉冲星、磁星或FRB，相关可转移性根据摘要无法判断。

title: Quiescent low-mass x-ray binaries are back - Mass-radius measurements to constrain dense matter
summary: Neutron star low-mass X-ray binaries, in particular those in quiescence, were intensively used, over the past 15 years to determine the neutron star masses and radii by spectroscopy of the NS surface thermal emission. However, over time, a series of potential sources of systematic biases on these measurements were put forth in the literature. This is because the spectroscopic method required making assumptions. Among the most critical ones are the assumptions of a non-rotating neutron star, and of a neutron star surface emitting uniformly. It was shown that these can cause biases on the radius by as much as ∼ 40%. Consequently, these M-R measurements from low-mass X-ray binaries were supplanted by those from the pulse profile modelling of millisecond pulsars (e.g., with NICER data). However, I will show that the aforementioned assumptions are no longer necessary. Thanks to new tools permitting realistic modelling., we can now control the related systematics, ensuring an unbiased measurement of the radius from low-mass X-ray binaries. I will present the first results that will bring back quiescence low-mass X-ray binaries to the forefront of mass-radius measurements and constraints on the dense matter equation of state.

AI.abstract_translation: 中子星低质量X射线双星，尤其是处于宁静期（quiescence）的那些，在过去15年间被广泛用于通过中子星表面热辐射的光谱分析来确定中子星的质量和半径。然而，随着时间推移，文献中提出了这些测量可能存在的系统性偏差的一系列来源。这是因为光谱方法需要作出假设。其中最关键的假设包括：中子星不旋转，以及中子星表面均匀发射。已有研究表明，这些假设可能对半径造成高达约40%的偏差。因此，这些来自低质量X射线双星的M-R测量被来自毫秒脉冲星脉冲轮廓建模（例如使用NICER数据）的测量所取代。然而，我将展示上述假设已不再必要。得益于能够进行现实建模的新工具，我们现在可以控制相关的系统效应，确保从低质量X射线双星获得无偏的半径测量。我将展示首批结果，这些结果将使宁静期低质量X射线双星重新回到质量-半径测量以及对致密物质状态方程约束的前沿。
AI.tldr: 该研究声称，通过能够进行现实建模的新工具，宁静态低质量X射线双星中先前对半径测量造成偏差的假设（不旋转、表面均匀发射）已不再必要，可据此获得无偏的中子星半径测量，从而将这类天体重新带回到质量-半径测量与致密物质状态方程约束的前沿。
AI.motivation: 过去15年间，宁静态低质量X射线双星被用于通过光谱方法测量中子星质量与半径，但该方法依赖不旋转和表面均匀发射等假设，可能对半径造成高达约40%的偏差，从而被毫秒脉冲星脉冲轮廓建模所取代。本工作的动因是克服这些假设带来的系统性偏差。
AI.method: 摘要未说明。
AI.result: 摘要报告了首批结果，表明前述关于不旋转和表面均匀发射的假设经现实建模后已不再必要，相关系统效应可以被控制，从而确保从宁静态低质量X射线双星获得无偏的半径测量。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，新工具支持的现实建模能够控制先前的系统效应，因此宁静态低质量X射线双星可以重新用于质量-半径测量并对致密物质状态方程提供约束。根据摘要无法判断。

title: Super-orbital period evolution of Her X-1
summary: Her X-1 is an intermediate (or low) mass X-ray binary pulsar that exhibits a ∼35-day super-orbital modulation whose origin-disc precession or neutron-star free precession-remains debated. Earlier work reported stochastic variations without a clear long-term trend. Using ∼50 years of data from CGRO/BATSE, RXTE/ASM, SWIFT/BAT, FERMI/GBM, and MAXI/GSC supplemented with archival measurements, we studied the long-term evolution of this modulation. Three methods are applied: epoch-folding searches for constant periods, χ^2 maximisation in the period─period-derivative space, and timing of main-on peaks via an O-C analysis. All approaches consistently show a long term decrease in the super-orbital period at a rate of ∼ -10^-5 s s^-1, with additional short-timescale variabilities superposed on this trend. The possible mechanisms for the observed decay of the super-orbital period will be discussed.

AI.abstract_translation: Her X-1是一颗中等（或低）质量X射线双星脉冲星，表现出约35天的超轨道调制，其起源——盘进动或中子星自由进动——仍有争议。此前的工作报道了随机变化，而没有明确的长期趋势。利用CGRO/BATSE、RXTE/ASM、SWIFT/BAT、FERMI/GBM和MAXI/GSC约50年的数据，并补充了档案测量，我们研究了这种调制的长期演化。应用了三种方法：在恒定周期上的epoch-folding搜索、周期-周期导数空间上的χ²最大化，以及通过O-C分析对主亮峰顶(the main-on peaks)进行计时。所有方法一致表明超轨道周期呈长期下降，速率约为10^{-5} s s^{-1}，在此趋势上叠加了额外的短时标变化。将讨论观测到的超轨道周期衰减的可能机制。
AI.tldr: Her X-1的超轨道调制周期呈现长期下降，速率约为10^{-5} s s^{-1}。该结论通过约50年的多卫星数据与三种独立分析方法一致得出。
AI.motivation: Her X-1是一颗具有约35天超轨道调制的中等（或低）质量X射线双星脉冲星，但其起源（盘进动或中子星自由进动）仍有争议。此前工作仅报道随机变化而无明确长期趋势，因此需要利用更长数据跨度来检验超轨道周期的长期演化。
AI.method: 利用约50年来自CGRO/BATSE、RXTE/ASM、SWIFT/BAT、FERMI/GBM和MAXI/GSC的数据，并补充档案测量。采用三种方法：在恒定周期上的epoch-folding搜索、周期-周期导数空间中的χ²最大化，以及通过O-C分析对主亮峰顶进行计时。
AI.result: 三种方法一致表明Her X-1的超轨道周期存在长期下降，速率约为-10^{-5} s s^{-1}。在此长期趋势上叠加了额外的短时标变化。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出所有方法一致显示超轨道周期的长期衰减，并称将讨论该衰减的可能机制。摘要未明确判定盘进动或中子星自由进动之争中的哪一解释，也未陈述对脉冲星或快速射电暴的推广。

title: Cyclotron lines in subcritical X-ray pulsars: Examining their variability with luminosity and pulse phase
summary: Cyclotron Resonant Scattering Features (CRSFs) in the spectra of accreting X-ray pulsars (XRPs) are the only direct diagnostic of the magnetic-field strength near the neutron-star surface, and thus, they are essential for probing the physics of these extreme environments. However, their interpretation remains a challenging task as observations have shown that in many cases the line features depend strongly on the X-ray luminosity L and the pulse phase. Of particular interest is the positive correlation observed in low-luminosity XRPs between L and both centroid energy of the CRSF (E_CRSF) and line width (σ_CRSF). In this work, we examine the physical mechanisms driving these trends, specifically the roles of resonant scattering and relativistic plasma motion within the accretion funnel. We adopt the analytical plasma-density and velocity profiles proposed by Mushtukov et al. (2015) to account for the effects of radiation pressure on the flow. To test whether this framework can explain the observed CRSF variability in subcritical XRPs, we developed a relativistic Monte Carlo radiative transfer code featuring an adaptive step-size algorithm. We performed detailed calculations to obtain angle-resolved spectra, varying the accretion luminosity to explore the resulting evolution of the CRSF properties. Our simulations reveal that the emergent spectra exhibit prominent, asymmetric CRSFs accompanied by a broad blue wing. The simulated lines are systematically redshifted relative to the classical cyclotron energy, with the magnitude of this redshift decreasing at higher luminosities and larger viewing angles with respect to the magnetic field. We successfully reproduce the observed positive correlation of E_CRSF and σ_CRSF with luminosity. Crucially, we find that the absolute values of these quantities are sensitive to the viewing angle θ, with E_CRSF and σ_CRSF exhibiting negative and positive correlations with cosθ, respectively. Therefore, we predict that future phase-resolved observations will reveal an anti-correlation between E_CRSF and σ_CRSF. To validate the model, we performed a consistency check using observational data of the XRP GX 304-1, adopting physical parameters appropriate for this system. The model successfully reproduces the observed CRSF variability over nearly an order of magnitude in luminosity for geometries in which the accretion funnel is predominantly viewed edge-on.

AI.abstract_translation: 在吸积X射线脉冲星（XRPs）光谱中的回旋共振散射特征（CRSFs）是探测中子星表面附近磁场强度的唯一直接诊断手段，因此它们对于探究这些极端环境的物理至关重要。然而，对它们的解释仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为观测表明在许多情况下谱线特征强烈依赖于X射线光度L和脉冲相位。特别令人关注的是，在低光度XRP中观测到的L与CRSF质心能量（E_CRSF）及谱线宽度（σ_CRSF）之间的正相关。在这项工作中，我们考察了驱动这些趋势的物理机制，特别是吸积漏斗内共振散射和相对论性等离子体运动所起的作用。我们采用Mushtukov等人（2015）提出的解析等离子体密度和速度分布，以考虑辐射压力对流动的影响。为检验该框架能否解释亚临界XRP中观测到的CRSF变化，我们开发了一个采用自适应步长算法的相对论性Monte Carlo辐射转移代码。我们进行了详细计算以获取角分辨光谱，改变吸积光度以探讨CRSF性质随之产生的演化。我们的模拟表明，涌现光谱呈现出显著且不对称的CRSF，并伴有宽的蓝翼。相对于经典回旋能量，模拟谱线系统地红移，且该红移的幅度在更高光度和相对于磁场更大的观测角度下减小。我们成功重现了E_CRSF和σ_CRSF与光度的正相关。关键在于，我们发现这些量的绝对值对观测角度θ敏感，其中E_CRSF和σ_CRSF分别与cosθ呈负相关和正相关。因此，我们预测未来的相位分辨观测将揭示E_CRSF与σ_CRSF之间的反相关。为验证该模型，我们使用XRP GX 304-1的观测数据进行了自洽性检验，采用了适合该系统的物理参数。对于吸积漏斗主要以侧视几何进行观测的情形，该模型成功重现了近一个数量级光度范围内的CRSF变化。
AI.tldr: 本文通过相对论性Monte Carlo辐射转移模拟，研究了亚临界吸积X射线脉冲星中CRSF随光度与观测角度的变化，成功重现E_CRSF和σ_CRSF与光度的正相关，并用XRP GX 304-1的观测数据验证了模型。
AI.motivation: CRSF是探测中子星表面附近磁场强度的唯一直接诊断手段，但其解释具有挑战性，因为观测显示谱线特征强烈依赖于X射线光度L和脉冲相位，尤其是在低光度XRP中L与E_CRSF及σ_CRSF存在正相关。本文旨在考察驱动这些趋势背后的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用Mushtukov等人（2015）提出的解析等离子体密度和速度分布以考虑辐射压力的作用，并开发了一台采用自适应步长算法的相对论性Monte Carlo辐射转移代码。通过改变吸积光度进行详细计算以获取角分辨光谱，探讨吸积漏斗内共振散射和相对论性等离子体运动对CRSF演化的影响。
AI.result: 模拟揭示涌现光谱呈现显著且不对称的CRSF并带有宽的蓝翼；谱线相对经典回旋能量系统性红移，且该红移在更高光度和更大观测角度下减小。模型成功重现E_CRSF和σ_CRSF与光度的正相关；两者的绝对值对观测角度θ敏感，E_CRSF与cosθ呈负相关、σ_CRSF与cosθ呈正相关，因此预测E_CRSF与σ_CRSF之间存在反相关。使用XRP GX 304-1数据，对于吸积漏斗主要为侧视几何的情形，模型成功重现了近一个数量级光度范围内的CRSF变化。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，所提出的物理框架（包含辐射压力效应的解析流线分布及其中的共振散射与相对论性运动的Monte Carlo模拟）能够解释亚临界XRP中观测到的CRSF随光度与观测角度的变化，并预测未来的相位分辨观测将揭示E_CRSF与σ_CRSF之间的反相关。

title: GRB 260805D: SVOM/GRM detection of a possible magnetar burst
summary: SVOM/GRM detected GRB 260805D during the routine ground search at 2026-08-05T14:52:21.700 (T0), which is also detected by Fermi/GBM (TrigNum 807634346). With the event-by-event data downloaded through the X-band ground station, the GRM light curve shows that this burst mainly consists of two pulses with a T90 of 0.10 +0.03/-0.01 s in the 15-5000 keV band. The SVOM/GRM light curve can be found here: https://www.bursthub.cn/gcn/2026/svgrb260805D.png In addition, the position of this burst, according to Fermi/GBM localization (RA = 284.2, Dec = -32.2, err = 34.7 degs), is located at about 68.9 degrees from the SVOM optical axis, which is outside the ECLAIRs field of view. Triangulation between SVOM/GRM and Fermi/GBM (3 sigma): https://www.bursthub.cn/gcn/2026/svgrb260805D_triangulation.png Considering the short duration and soft spectrum of this burst, and location consistent with several magnetars, it is likely a magnetar burst. The Space Variable Objects Monitor (SVOM) is a China-France joint mission led by the Chinese National Space Administration (CNSA, China), National Center for Space Studies (CNES, France) and the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS, China), which is dedicated to observing gamma-ray bursts and other transient phenomena in the energetic universe. GRM is developed by the Institute of High Energy Physics (IHEP) of CAS. The SVOM/GRM point of contact for this burst is: Jin-Peng Zhang (IHEP) (zhangjinpeng@ihep.ac.cn)

AI.abstract_translation: SVOM/GRM在地面例行搜索中于2026-08-05T14:52:21.700（T0）探测到GRB 260805D，该暴也被Fermi/GBM探测到（TrigNum 807634346）。利用通过X波段地面站下载的逐事件数据，GRM光变曲线表明该暴主要由两个脉冲组成，在15-5000 keV能段的T90为0.10 +0.03/-0.01 s。SVOM/GRM光变曲线可见于：https://www.bursthub.cn/gcn/2026/svgrb260805D.png 此外，根据Fermi/GBM定位（RA = 284.2，Dec = -32.2，误差 = 34.7度），该暴的位置位于距SVOM光轴约68.9度处，处于ECLAIRs视场之外。SVOM/GRM与Fermi/GBM之间的三角定位（3σ）：https://www.bursthub.cn/gcn/2026/svgrb260805D_triangulation.png 考虑到该暴持续时间短且能谱较软，且位置与若干磁星一致，它很可能是一次磁星爆发。太空变源监视器（SVOM）是中国-法国联合任务，由国家航天局（CNSA，中国）、法国国家空间研究中心（CNES，法国）和中国科学院（CAS，中国）牵头，致力于观测伽马射线暴及高能宇宙中的其他瞬变现象。GRM由中国科学院高能物理研究所（IHEP）研制。该暴的SVOM/GRM联系人：张金鹏（IHEP）（zhangjinpeng@ihep.ac.cn）

AI.method: 利用SVOM/GRM通过X波段地面站下载的逐事件数据构建光变曲线；能段为15-5000 keV，测得T90。结合Fermi/GBM的探测（TrigNum 807634346）及其定位结果（RA = 284.2，Dec = -32.2，误差 = 34.7度），并利用SVOM/GRM与Fermi/GBM之间的三角定位进行分析。
AI.result: GRB 260805D于2026-08-05T14:52:21.700（T0）被SVOM/GRM探测，亦被Fermi/GBM探测（TrigNum 807634346）。光变曲线主要由两个脉冲组成，15-5000 keV能段T90为0.10 +0.03/-0.01 s。位置依据Fermi/GBM定位为RA = 284.2，Dec = -32.2（误差34.7度），距SVOM光轴约68.9度，处于ECLAIRs视场之外。
