title: X-ray views of Galactic PeVatrons: Probing particle acceleration, transport and cooling mechanisms through synchrotron radiation
summary: The recent discovery of 50 ultra-high-energy (UHE; E > 100 TeV) gamma-ray sources and neutrino emission along the Galactic Plane has provided compelling evidence for the existence of Galactic PeVatrons. Previous studies of TeV gamma-ray sources have demonstrated that X-ray observations play a crucial role in identifying these extreme particle accelerators by detecting synchrotron emission from primary and secondary TeV-PeV electrons. In particular, a combination of broadband spectral energy distributions (SEDs) and morphological data in the X-ray and TeV bands is a powerful tool for investigating particle acceleration, transport and energy-loss mechanisms. In this review talk, I will highlight recent X-ray observations of Galactic PeVatron candidates, including young supernova remnants, pulsar wind nebulae, microquasars, the Galactic Center and so-called dark PeVatrons. Finally, I will discuss the prospects of X-ray astrophysics in advancing our understanding of Galactic PeVatrons.

AI.abstract_translation: 近期在银道面上发现的50个超高能（UHE；E > 100 TeV）伽马射线源以及中微子发射，为银河系PeVatrons的存在提供了令人信服的证据。先前对TeV伽马射线源的研究已表明，X射线观测在识别这些极端粒子加速器中发挥着关键作用，其方式是通过探测来自初级和次级TeV–PeV电子的同步辐射。特别是，X射线与TeV波段的宽带能谱能量分布（SEDs）与形态学数据的结合，是研究粒子加速、输运和能量损耗机制的有力工具。在这篇综述报告中，我将重点介绍近期对银河系PeVatron候选体（包括年轻超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云、微类星体、银河系中心以及所谓的暗PeVatrons）的X射线观测。最后，我将讨论X射线天体物理学在加深我们对银河系PeVatrons理解方面的前景。
AI.tldr: 该综述基于X射线波段同步辐射观测，强调近期对银河系PeVatron候选体（包括年轻超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云、微类星体、银河系中心和暗PeVatrons）的研究，并以X射线天体物理学的未来前景作结。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，沿银道面发现50个超高能（UHE；E > 100 TeV）伽马射线源及中微子发射，为银河系PeVatrons的存在提供了证据；但需通过X射线观测探测同步辐射来识别这些极端粒子加速器，并探查粒子加速、输运与能量损耗机制。
AI.method: 摘要未说明具体观测数据、仪器、频率或时间跨度。其方法描述为综述式地结合X射线与TeV波段的宽带能谱能量分布（SEDs）和形态学数据进行研究，重点利用X射线观测探测来自初级和次级TeV–PeV电子的同步辐射。
AI.result: 摘要指出近期沿银道面发现50个超高能（UHE；E > 100 TeV）伽马射线源以及中微子发射，作为银河系PeVatrons存在的证据；并说明先前研究已表明X射线观测可通过探测同步辐射发挥关键作用。文中未报告具体数值结果或显著性。
AI.conclusion: 作者隐含的结论是：X射线观测与TeV能谱、形态学数据结合是研究粒子加速、输运和能量损耗机制的有力工具。摘要未明确支持其与脉冲星、磁星或FRB等具体物理机制的关联解释，根据摘要无法判断是否涉及上述联系。

title: Energy- and Spatially-Resolved Polarization Analysis of the Crab Nebula with IXPE
summary: The Crab Nebula is an archetypal pulsar wind nebula and one of the most extensively studied synchrotron sources across the electromagnetic spectrum. In the X-ray band, its emission is dominated by synchrotron radiation from ultra-relativistic electrons, that defines its complex morphology, characterized by a bright equatorial torus and polar jets aligned with the pulsar spin axis, reflects the complex interplay between relativistic particle acceleration and magnetic field geometry. Because synchrotron radiation is intrinsically polarized, X-ray polarimetry provides a direct probe of the magnetic field structure in different regions of the nebula. Previous studies have revealed spatial variations in polarization degree and polarization angle between the torus and the jets (alongside spectral variations), suggesting differences in magnetic field ordering across the nebula. At the same time, the Crab exhibits an energy-dependent morphology, becoming progressively more compact at higher X-ray energies due to synchrotron enery loss. Further recent analyses indicate that polarization properties may also evolve with energy. Building on these indications, we present an energy and spatially-resolved X-ray polarization study of the Crab Nebula using multiple IXPE observations. The aim of this work is to investigate how the polarization degree and angle vary both across distinct morphological regions and as a function of energy along the source. In particular, we will present polarization maps obtained in different energy bands, allowing a direct comparison of the polarization pattern and magnetic field orientation at increasing energies. By measuring the polarization properties of the torus and jets in separate energy intervals, we explore how spatial and spectral dependencies combine, and whether the magnetic field structure inferred from polarization evolves with energy within individual regions.

AI.abstract_translation: 蟹状星云是典型的脉冲星风云，也是电磁波谱中被研究最为广泛的同步辐射源之一。在X射线波段，其辐射主要由来自超高相对论性电子的同步辐射主导，这决定了其复杂的形态，其特征是明亮的赤道环面以及与脉冲星自转轴对齐的极向喷流，反映了相对论性粒子加速与磁场几何结构之间复杂的相互作用。由于同步辐射本质上是偏振的，X射线偏振测量为探测星云不同区域中的磁场结构提供了一种直接手段。已有研究揭示了环面与喷流之间偏振度和偏振角的空间变化（同时伴随光谱变化），表明星云各区域的磁场有序性存在差异。与此同时，蟹状星云呈现出随能量变化的形态，由于同步辐射能量损失，其在更高X射线能量下变得逐渐更致密。进一步的近期分析表明，偏振性质也可能随能量演化。基于这些迹象，我们利用多次IXPE观测，对蟹状星云开展了一项能量分辨且空间分辨的X射线偏振研究。本工作的目的是研究偏振度和偏振角如何在不同形态区域之间变化，以及作为能量的函数沿源如何变化。特别是，我们将展示在不同能带中获得的偏振图，从而能够直接比较随着能量增加时的偏振图案与磁场取向。通过在各自的能量区间内测量环面和喷流的偏振性质，我们探索空间与光谱依赖关系如何结合，以及在单个区域内由偏振推断出的磁场结构是否随能量演化。
AI.tldr: 本文利用多次IXPE观测，对蟹状星云开展能量分辨且空间分辨的X射线偏振研究，考察偏振度和偏振角如何随形态区域及能量变化，并比较不同能带下的偏振图和磁场取向。
AI.motivation: 蟹状星云是脉冲星风云和同步辐射源的原型，其X射线同步辐射本质偏振，是探测各区域磁场结构的直接手段。已有研究表明偏振性质在空间（环面与喷流间）可能随能量演化，但空间与光谱依赖如何结合尚不清楚，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 摘要说明采用多次IXPE观测进行能量分辨且空间分辨的X射线偏振研究；在不同能带获得偏振图；在各自能量区间内分别测量环面和喷流的偏振性质，比较偏振图案与磁场取向随能量增加的变化。摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度、能带数值区间或样本细节。
AI.result: 本文给出了对蟹状星云在不同能带下的偏振图，可在能量升高时直接比较偏振图案与磁场取向；并通过对环面与喷流在分离能量区间内的偏振测量，考察偏振随区域与能量的变化。摘要未报告具体的偏振度或偏振角数值及其变化结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究旨在通过能量分辨且空间分辨的偏振测量，检验环面与喷流等区域内磁场结构是否随能量演化，并探索空间与光谱依赖如何组合。蟹状星云对研究相对论性粒子加速及磁场几何结构具有意义，但摘要未给出最终物理结论，因此对偏振性质随能量的具体演化的确定性判断根据摘要无法判断。

title: Galactic X-ray transients in first eROSITA all sky survey
summary: Although a multitude of studies have focused on targeted observations of Galactic X-ray transients, blind surveys and population studies have been limited. We have used the ROSAT, eROSITA and Gaia source catalogs to find Galactic X-ray transients having timescales <30 years. We report the properties of 738 transients found in our search, majority of which are active stars or interacting binaries. We have also found ∼40 compact object systems among which are at least 8 newly-identified white-dwarf systems, 3 known X-ray binaries, and one known pulsar. We use eROSITA (soft X-ray) spectra of the Galactic transients to show that two distinct types of flaring systems are prevalent: one having peak around 1 keV, well fit by thermal models, and another having peak below 0.2 keV and requiring a power-law component. Our study also reveals that single star or interacting binary systems (X-ray transients) involving giant stars exhibit significantly higher X-ray luminosities than systems involving only main-sequence stars or young stellar objects. Finally, we discuss the properties of the transients in the context of their putative emission mechanisms, the fraction of transients with respect to the total population, and the rates of Galactic transients expected in blind searches of the X-ray sky.

AI.abstract_translation: 尽管大量研究集中于对银河系X射线暂现源的目标性观测，但盲巡天和群体研究仍然有限。我们利用ROSAT、eROSITA和Gaia源星表来寻找时标<30年的银河系X射线暂现源。我们报告了在搜寻中发现的738个暂现源的性质，其中多数为活跃恒星或相互作用双星。我们还发现了约40个致密天体系统，其中包括至少8个新识别的白矮星系统、3个已知X射线双星以及1个已知脉冲星。我们利用eROSITA（软X射线）光谱的银河系暂现源谱来表明，存在两类主要的耀发系统：一类峰值在约1 keV附近，能被热模型很好地拟合；另一类峰值低于0.2 keV，需要幂律分量。我们的研究还揭示，涉及巨星的单星或相互作用双星系统（X射线暂现源）表现出显著高于仅包含主序恒星或年轻恒星天体的系统的X射线光度。最后，我们在其假定辐射机制的背景下讨论了这些暂现源的性质、暂现源相对于总体的比例，以及在X射线天空盲搜寻中预期的银河系暂现源发生率。
AI.tldr: 该研究利用ROSAT、eROSITA和Gaia源星表搜索时标小于30年的银河系X射线暂现源，报告了738个暂现源的性质，多为活跃恒星或相互作用双星，并发现约40个致密天体系统，其中包括约1颗已知脉冲星。
AI.motivation: 尽管针对点源的银河系X射线暂现源研究众多，但盲巡天与群体研究仍很有限。本研究旨在利用多源星表开展系统性的巡天搜索，刻画银河系X射线暂现源的群体性质、辐射机制、相对比例与发生率，填补该类群体普查的空白。
AI.method: 采用ROSAT、eROSITA和Gaia源星表交叉比对，筛选时标<30年的Galaxy X射线暂现源；利用eROSITA软X射线光谱拟合（热模型、幂律分量）对暂现源进行分类；并对暂现源相对总体比例及发生率进行讨论。摘要未详述具体统计方法或数值参数。
AI.result: 共发现738个暂现源，多数为活跃恒星或相互作用双星；约40个为致密天体系统，包括至少8个新识别白矮星系统、3个已知X射线双星及1个已知脉冲星。光谱显示两类主要耀发系统：一类峰值约1 keV且可由热模型拟合，另一类峰值低于0.2 keV并需幂律分量；涉及巨星的系统X射线光度显著高于仅含主序星或年轻恒星天体的系统。
AI.conclusion: 作者在假定辐射机制背景下解释了暂现源的物理性质，说明了暂现源在总体中的比例及X射线盲搜寻中的预期发生率。摘要未明确针对脉冲星计时、单脉冲或FRB/Burst等具体研究给出确切结论。根据摘要无法判断其方法论对脉冲星领域的具体适用性。

title: Understanding the Appearance and Evolution of Accreting Supermassive Binary Black Holes
summary: Supermassive binary black holes are expected to be important evolutionary stages of galactic nuclei, however, they have remained elusive. While there are hints of these systems in the gravitational wave background as measured by pulsar timing arrays (PTAs), confirmation of individual sources are still years away with either PTAs or the ESA/NASA LISA mission. Through 3-d general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (GRMHD) simulations, our group aims to learn how accretion may produce electromagnetic signatures with which we may search for candidates and how it may affect the orbital evolution of the binaries. In this talk, we will present recent results exploring these two aspects. We will share results of merging binaries spanning the post-Newtonian (inspiral) to dynamic GR (merger to post-merger) regimes for the first time with relaxed initial conditions for the gas. We find that the Poynting flux and thermal luminosity change over the course of merger process for different spin configurations to varying degrees. Next, we will communicate new results on long-term GRMHD simulations of the circumbinary disk using a range of radiative loss rates. We find that hotter disks lead to greater rates of increasing binary separation but no significant affect on the rate of eccentricity growth. By using a different, more realistic model of radiative losses, using the so-called "leakage" method, we will show how one models radiative losses impacts the structure of the circumbinary disk and its accretion variability.

AI.abstract_translation: 超大质量双黑洞被认为是星系核的重要演化阶段，然而它们仍然难以探测到。虽然在脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）所测得的引力波背景中存在这些系统的迹象，但无论通过PTAs还是欧空局/NASA的LISA任务，对单个源的确认仍需要数年时间。通过三维广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟，我们课题组旨在了解吸积如何可能产生可供我们搜寻候选体的电磁信号，以及它如何可能影响双星的轨道演化。在本报告中，我们将展示探讨这两个方面的最新结果。我们将首次分享跨越后牛顿（旋进）到动态GR（并合至并合后）不同阶段、且气体具有松弛初始条件的并合双星结果。我们发现，庞加（Poynting）通量与热光度在并合过程的不同自旋构型中会以不同程度的幅度发生变化。接下来，我们将汇报采用一系列辐射损失率对环双星盘开展长期GRMHD模拟的新结果。我们发现，温度更高的盘会导致双星间距增大的速率更大，但对偏心率增长的速率没有显著影响。通过采用一种不同的、更真实的辐射损失模型（即所谓的“泄漏”（leakage）方法），我们将展示辐射损失的建模方式如何影响环双星盘的结构及其吸积变异性。
AI.tldr: 通过三维GRMHD模拟，作者研究了超大质量双黑洞吸积如何产生电磁信号并影响其轨道演化。结果显示并合过程中Poynting通量与热光度随自旋构型变化，且更热的环双星盘导致双星间距增大的速率更大，但对偏心率增长速率无显著影响。
AI.motivation: 超大质量双黑洞预期是星系核的重要演化阶段，却仍难以探测；虽在PTA引力波背景中见其迹象，单个源的确认仍遥遥无期。作者旨在了解吸积如何产生可供搜寻候选体的电磁信号及其如何影响双星轨道演化。
AI.method: 采用三维广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟。覆盖从后牛顿（旋进）到动态GR（并合至并合后）的并合双星，并使用气体松弛初始条件；同时对环双星盘开展采用不同辐射损失率以及“泄漏”方法的长期GRMHD模拟。
AI.result: 并合过程中，不同自旋构型下Poynting通量与热光度的变化程度各异；在环双星盘模拟中，更热的盘导致双星间距增大的速率更大，但对偏心率增长速率无显著影响；采用更具真实性的“泄漏”辐射损失模型会影响盘的结及其吸积变异性。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为吸积过程可产生可供搜寻候选体的电磁信号，并影响双星轨道演化。辐射处理方式会影响环双星盘结构与吸积变异性。根据摘要无法判断。

title: Strategic Technical Framework for Space-borne and Lunar Radio Astronomy: Korea's Roadmap
summary: This paper presents the strategic roadmap of Korea (KASA/KASI) for next-generation space and lunar radio astronomy, focusing on several core technologies. Key technical specifications include 300 GHz SIS receivers with 4.5 K cryogenic cooling, m-class solid-petal deployable antennas with <40 μm RMS surface accuracy, and 64 Gbps optical communication terminals. Beyond the millimeter-wave regime, a key innovation in this framework is the extension of Space VLBI to sub-GHz bands in synergy with the Square Kilometre Array (SKA). Following Korea's commitment to joining the SKAO, we propose the installation of low-frequency (sub-GHz) antennas on SVLBI platforms. This strategy enables ultra-long baselines extending beyond Earth's diameter, providing milli-arcsecond (mas) resolution in low-frequency bands. Such synergy with SKA1-Low/Mid will revolutionize studies on the Universe's "Dark Ages," pulsar timing, and exoplanetary magnetospheres. Additionally, we outline the autonomous deployment of lunar surface arrays using rovers and survival strategies for the extreme 14-day lunar night (-170^∘ C) via DTN and advanced thermal control. This comprehensive framework establishes Korea as a key technological partner in future international flagship missions.

AI.abstract_translation: 本文介绍了韩国（KASA/KASI）面向下一代空间和月球射电天文学的战略路线图，重点关注若干核心技术。关键技术指标包括带有4.5 K低温制冷的300 GHz SIS接收机、具有<40 μm RMS表面精度的米级固体瓣式可展开天线，以及64 Gbps光通信终端。在毫米波波段之外，该框架的一项关键创新是将空间甚长基线干涉测量（Space VLBI）扩展至亚GHz频段，并与平方公里阵列（SKA）协同。继韩国承诺加入SKAO之后，我们提议在SVLBI平台上安装低频（亚GHz）天线。该策略能够实现超越地球直径的超长基线，在低频波段提供毫角秒（mas）级分辨率。与SKA1-Low/Mid的这种协同作用将革新对宇宙“黑暗时代”、脉冲星计时（pulsar timing）以及系外行星磁层的研究。此外，我们还概述了利用漫游车自主部署月球表面阵列的情况，以及通过DTN和先进热控制应对极端14天月夜（-170^∘ C）的生存策略。这一综合框架使韩国成为未来国际旗舰任务中的关键技术合作伙伴。
AI.tldr: 该论文提出韩国的空间与月球射电天文学战略路线图，其核心技术包括300 GHz SIS接收机、米级可展开天线和64 Gbps光通信，并创新性地将Space VLBI扩展至与SKA协同的亚GHz频段，以实现超出地球直径的超长基线和低频毫角秒分辨率，进而支撑对宇宙“黑暗时代”、脉冲星计时与系外行星磁层的研究。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在论证和规划韩国在下一代空间与月球射电天文学中的核心技术能力，识别出将Space VLBI扩展至与SKA协同的亚GHz频段这一关键创新方向，以填补超长基线低频观测的技术空白并确立韩国作为国际旗舰任务合作伙伴的地位。
AI.method: 论文以战略路线图/框架性论述为主，列出关键技术指标：300 GHz SIS接收机（4.5 K低温制冷）、m级固体瓣式可展开天线（<40 μm RMS）、64 Gbps光通信终端；提出在SVLBI平台安装低频（sub-GHz）天线并与SKA1-Low/Mid协同；概述利用漫游车自主部署月球表面阵列，并以DTN和先进热控制应对14天月夜（-170^∘ C）。摘要未说明具体观测数据、观测时间或样本。
AI.result: 论文所阐述的技术框架宣称可实现超出地球直径的超长基线，在低频波段提供毫角秒（mas）级分辨率；其与SKA1-Low/Mid的协同被认为将革新对宇宙“黑暗时代”、脉冲星计时和系外行星磁层的研究；同时概述了通过DTN与热控制支持月球阵列承受极端月夜的方案。该框架将使韩国成为国际旗舰任务中的关键技术伙伴。
AI.conclusion: 作者的明确结论是：所提出的综合技术框架能够建立韩国在下一代空间和月球射电天文学中的关键技术地位，尤其通过Space VLBI与SKA协同实现低频超长基线观测。摘要中的相关能力（脉冲星计时等）属于路线图预期应用目标，而非常规观测成果；摘要未提供观测证据以支持实现这些目标的实证结论。根据摘要无法判断。

title: 3D Modelling of PeVatron Candidates: A case study on HESS J1616-508
summary: HESS J1616-508 is one of the most prominent, unidentified gamma-ray sources in the H.E.S.S. Galactic plane survey. Extending to the TeV regime and with no clear cut-off in the HESS energy spectrum, it is a PeVatron candidate. Despite extensive multi-wavelength and interstellar medium (ISM) investigations, there has not been convincing evidence for association with known accelerators in its vicinity, such as supernova remnants or pulsar wind nebulae. High-energy gamma rays can be produced via hadronic and leptonic processes. Cosmic-ray (CR) protons interact with the ISM to produce neutral pions which decay to gamma rays, and CR electrons undergo loss processes such as inverse-Compton scattering and bremsstrahlung. Accurately modelling distributions of CR electrons and the resultant gamma-ray distributions requires numerical solutions to simulate complex processes, such as leptonic energy loss, inhomogeneous ISM fields and advection. 3D modelling considers the spatial distance between sources that cannot be achieved in 2D models and may reveal the associated accelerator to HESS J1616-508. In this contribution, we showcase our novel 3D modelling method, to simulate the CR and gamma-ray morphology around HESS J1616-508, using molecular hydrogen gas distributions from the Mopra CO survey and comparing with gamma-ray observations from HESS. We will discuss how numerical modelling is necessary for accurate CR distributions in three dimensions, how these impact modelled gamma-ray morphologies and can lead to the uncovering of the responsible accelerator.

AI.abstract_translation: HESS J1616-508 是 H.E.S.S. 银道面巡天中最显著、尚未证认的伽玛射线源之一。它能延伸至 TeV 能段，且其 HESS 能谱中没有明显的截止，因此是 PeVatron（PeV 加速器）候选体。尽管已开展了大量的多波段和星际介质（ISM）研究，但仍没有令人信服的证据表明它与周围已知的加速天体（如超新星遗迹或脉冲星星风云）存在关联。高能伽玛射线可通过强子过程和轻子过程产生。宇宙线（CR）质子与 ISM 相互作用产生中性π介子，后者衰变成伽玛射线；而 CR 电子则经历诸如逆康普顿散射和轫致辐射等损耗过程。要精确模拟 CR 电子的分布以及由此产生的伽玛射线分布，需要利用数值解来模拟复杂的物理过程，例如轻子能量损耗、非均匀的 ISM 场以及对流。3D 建模考虑了源之间的空间距离，这是 2D 模型无法实现的，并且可能揭示与 HESS J1616-508 相关的加速天体。在本报告中，我们展示我们新颖的 3D 建模方法，用以模拟 HESS J1616-508 周围的 CR 和伽玛射线形态，该方法使用来自 Mopra CO 巡天的分子氢气体分布，并与 HESS 的伽玛射线观测进行对比。我们将讨论为何数值建模对于准确获得三维 CR 分布是必要的，这些分布如何影响所模拟的伽玛射线形态，以及如何能够由此发现产生这些伽玛射线的负责任加速天体。
AI.tldr: 本文展示了针对 TeV 无截止、未被证认的 PeVatron 候选体 HESS J1616-508 的新颖 3D 建模方法，模拟其宇宙线和伽玛射线形态，旨在揭示与之关联的加速天体。
AI.motivation: HESS J1616-508 是 H.E.S.S. 巡天中显著的未证认 TeV 伽玛射线源，是 PeVatron 候选体，但与其附近已知加速天体（如超新星遗迹或脉冲星星风云）的关联尚无令人信服的证据。2D 模型无法考虑源间的空间距离，促使作者开发 3D 建模以寻找负责的加速天体。这是基于摘要直接支持的背景。
AI.method: 摘要说明了一种新颖的 3D 数值建模方法，用于模拟 HESS J1616-508 周围的宇宙线（CR）和伽玛射线形态，包括轻子能量损耗、非均匀 ISM 场及对流等过程的数值解。该方法使用来自 Mopra CO 巡天的分子氢气体分布，并与 HESS 的伽玛射线观测进行对比。观察、观测时间跨度等详情未说明。
AI.result: 摘要展示了所开发的 3D 建模方法在 HESS J1616-508 上的应用，以模拟其周围 CR 和伽玛射线形态。文中指出 3D 建模能考虑源间空间距离（2D 模型无法实现），且可能揭示与 HESS J1616-508 相关的加速天体，但未给出具体的模拟结果、图像、数值或统计显著性。数字和显著性细节摘要未说明。
AI.conclusion: 作者论述认为数值建模对于在三微空间内获得准确的 CR 分布是必要的，这些分布会影响所模拟的伽玛射线形态，并可能由此发现产生这些射线的负责任加速天体。这些属于文中陈述的方法论述。关于与脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

title: Primordial black hole contribution to the stochastic background of gravitational waves
summary: Context. The amplitude of the detected stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) measured by pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and the discovery of early and over-massive central black holes at high redshift by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) challenge current models of supermassive black hole (SMBH) formation. Aims. We aim to study if halos containing a significant population of primordial black holes (PBHs) would increase the amplitude of the PTA signal. PBHs add an iso-curvature component to the matter power spectrum, accelerating the formation and merger of dark-matter halos at all redshifts. Methods. We propose that black holes in the halo sink to the center via dynamical friction. The central black hole grows through hierarchical merging in addition to the gas-accretion channel. We computed the resulting GW amplitude and performed a Bayesian inference analysis using the NANOGrav 15-year dataset. Results. We show that the predicted amplitude of the gravitational-wave background agrees with the observations. Our model only requires 0.09%-0.12% of the total mass of the halo to fall to the center; this is compatible with a fraction of f<SUB>pbh</SUB> ~ 0.1 PBHs being dark matter if the in-falling PBHs in the stellar mass range represent about 1% of the total population, as was found in our previous estimation of the formation of SMBHs at z ~ 6 - 10. Conclusions. The PBH model that explains the JWST new found populations of SMBHs also explain the amplitude of the stochastic background of gravitational waves.

AI.abstract_translation: 背景（Context）。由脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）测得的随机引力波背景（SGWB）的振幅，以及詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）在高红移处发现的早期且质量超大的中心黑洞，对当前超大质量黑洞（SMBH）形成模型提出了挑战。目的（Aims）。我们旨在研究含有大量原初黑洞（PBHs）的晕是否会提高PTA信号的振幅。PBHs会在物质功率谱中增加一种等曲率（iso-curvature）分量，从而加速所有红移处暗物质晕的形成与并合。方法（Methods）。我们提出，晕中的黑洞通过动力学摩擦沉入中心。中心黑洞除了气体吸积通道之外，还通过层级并合而增长。我们计算了由此产生的引力波振幅，并使用NANOGrav 15年数据集进行了贝叶斯推断分析。结果（Results）。我们表明，所预测的引力波背景振幅与观测相符。我们的模型仅需要晕总质量的0.09%–0.12%落入中心；这与质量为暗物质的f<SUB>pbh</SUB>~0.1的PBH比例相容，前提是落入的恒星质量范围PBH约占总体的1%，正如我们先前对z~6–10处SMBH形成的估算所得。结论（Conclusions）。解释JWST新发现SMBH种群的PBH模型，同样也能解释随机引力波背景的振幅。
AI.tldr: 该研究提出，含有原初黑洞（PBHs）的暗物质晕通过动力学摩擦使黑洞沉入中心并经层级并合增长，其预言出的引力波背景振幅与脉冲星计时阵列观测相符，表明能解释JWST发现的高红移超大质量黑洞的PBH模型同样能解释随机引力波背景的振幅。
AI.motivation: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）测得的随机引力波背景（SGWB）振幅与JWST发现的高红移早期超大质量中央黑洞，对现有超大质量黑洞（SMBH）形成模型提出挑战。本文旨在研究含有大量原初黑洞（PBHs）的晕是否会提高PTA信号振幅。
AI.method: 摘要说明：提出PBHs在物质功率谱中增加等曲率分量以加速暗物质晕形成与并合；假设晕中黑洞经动力学摩擦沉入中心，中心黑洞经层级并合及气体吸积增长。计算所得引力波振幅，并使用NANOGrav 15年数据集进行贝叶斯推断分析。
AI.result: 结果显示预言出的引力波背景振幅与观测相符。模型仅需晕总质量的0.09%–0.12%落入中心，这与f<SUB>pbh</SUB>~0.1的PBH作为暗物质的比例相容，条件为落入的恒星质量范围PBH约占总体的1%（与先前对z~6–10处SMBH形成的估算一致）。
AI.conclusion: 作者结论认为，能够解释JWST新发现的SMBH种群的PBH模型，同时也解释了随机引力波背景的振幅，从而将高红移超大质量黑洞形成与脉冲星计时阵列观测到的引力波背景联系起来。

title: Radiative signatures of nonthermal particle acceleration from driven relativistic reconnection in merging flux tubes
summary: High-energy emission from ultra-relativistic particles is present in a wide variety of astrophysical systems, providing an important link between observational multi-messenger data and fundamental physical processes that still need to be fully explored. Especially for the case of unreproducible complex systems, e.g., accretion flows around black holes or pulsar-wind nebulae, radiative signatures represent a key means of probing and understanding the extreme physics occurring in those locations. In the magnetosphere of compact objects, magnetised relativistic plasmas are ideal sites for such extreme acceleration phenomena, where relativistic magnetic reconnection is a prime candidate in powering explosive releases of magnetic energy. We investigate the outcome of nonthermal particle acceleration and synchrotron emission from particle-in-cell (PIC) numerical simulations of two reconnecting force-free flux tubes of pair plasma, initially pushed together by an external drive of a few tens of percent of the speed of light. This setup offers a novel approach to model relativistic reconnection from the onset. Indeed, in the surroundings of compact objects, magnetic structures can coalesce explosively when twisted and sheared by strongly accreting flows and relativistic frame-dragging effects. We characterise the system scaling for different magnetisation parameter values, analysing the formation of very high-energy tails in particle energy distributions and potential power-law behaviour. We reconstruct synchrotron radiation from local particle quantities and derive the temporal and spatial evolution of the total emission, with the purpose of gaining insight for interpreting and predicting observations. This work presents a primary study, with broad applicability, for modelling energetic flaring events in relativistic astrophysical plasmas and linking them to observational data.

AI.abstract_translation: 来自超相对论粒子的高能辐射存在于各种各样的天体物理系统中，为观测的多信使数据与仍需充分探索的基础物理过程之间提供了重要联系。特别是对于不可重复复现的复杂系统，例如黑洞周围的吸积流或脉冲星风云（pulsar-wind nebulae），辐射特征代表了探测和理解这些位置所发生的极端物理过程的关键手段。在致密天体的磁层中，磁化的相对论等离子体是此类极端加速现象的理想场所，其中相对论性磁重联是驱动磁能爆发性释放的主要候选机制。我们研究了来自两个正在发生重联的无张力磁通管（由几成光速的外部驱动初始推动到一起的电子-正电子等离子体构成）的粒子模拟（particle-in-cell, PIC）数值模拟所产生的非热粒子加速和同步加速辐射的结果。这一设置提供了一种从开端模拟相对论性重联的新方法。实际上，在致密天体的周围，当磁结构被强吸积流和相对论性参考系拖曳效应扭曲和剪切时，它们可以爆发性地并合。我们在不同的磁化参数值下刻画系统的标度关系，分析粒子能量分布中甚高能尾的形成以及可能的幂律行为。我们从局部粒子量重构同步加速辐射，并推导总辐射的时间与空间演化，其目的在于为解释和预测观测提供洞见。这项工作提出了一项具有广泛适用性的初步研究，用于模拟相对论性天体物理等离子体中的高能耀发事件，并将其与观测数据联系起来。
AI.tldr: 通过PIC数值模拟研究两个由外部驱动并合的、重联的无张力磁通管中非热粒子加速与同步加速辐射，刻画了不同磁化参数下的能谱尾和幂律行为，并推出总辐射的时空演化。这项工作为模拟致密天体环境中高能耀发事件并将其与观测联系提供了具有广泛适用性的初步框架。
AI.motivation: 超相对论粒子高能辐射广泛存在于天体物理系统中，是联系多信使观测与基础物理过程的关键。在吸积流、脉冲星风云等复杂系统及致密天体磁层中，磁化的相对论等离子体是极端加速的理想场所，而相对论性磁重联被视作驱动磁能爆发释放的主要候选机制，因而需要研究其粒子加速与辐射结果。
AI.method: 采用粒子模拟（particle-in-cell, PIC）数值方法，对两个由外部驱动（初始推动速度约为光速的百分之几十）并合、发生重联的无张力（force-free）电子-正电子等离子体磁通管进行模拟。在不同磁化参数值下刻画系统标度，分析粒子能量分布的甚高能尾及幂律行为，并从局部粒子量重构同步加速辐射，推导总辐射的时间与空间演化。时间跨度、样本数量、具体仪器及数值均未在摘要中具体说明。
AI.result: 摘要报告了重联模拟中非热粒子加速及同步加速辐射的谱与时空演化结果：刻画了不同磁化参数值下的系统标度关系，分析了粒子能量分布中甚高能尾的形成以及潜在幂律行为的特征，并推导了总辐射的时间与空间演化，但未给出具体数值、显著性或定量能谱指数。该工作被定位为模拟相对论性天体物理等离子体中高能耀发事件并联系观测的初步（primary）研究。
AI.conclusion: 作者的结论是：该PIC模拟框架为从启动阶段模拟致密天体周围由吸积流与参考系拖曳效应驱动并合的磁结构中的相对论性重联及同步加速辐射提供了一种新方法，所推导的辐射时空演化可用于解释和预测耀发事件的观测。本摘要未提及对脉冲星、磁星或FRB的具体观测应用，因此根据摘要无法判断其对上述具体对象与观测数据的直接转移性。

title: On the Imaging of Supermassive Black Hole Binaries
summary: Compelling evidence has been presented by the North American Nanohertz Observatory for Gravitational Waves (NANOGrav) and other international pulsar timing array consortia for a stochastic gravitational wave background at nanohertz frequencies. The existence of such a stochastic gravitational wave background has been expected based on projections from mergers of galaxies and the likely occupation fraction of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in galaxies—as galaxies merge, the SMBHs in their centers should spiral together to form gravitational wave-emitting binaries. However, the amplitude of the stochastic gravitational wave background is higher than initial expectations, leading to suggestions that there may be other contributions to the stochastic gravitational wave background, such as physics beyond the Standard Model or extensions of the Hot Big Bang model. If SMBH binaries are the dominant contribution to the stochastic gravitational wave background, there should be a "local" population of SMBH binaries with sub-parsec semi-major axes. The expected angular separation of the SMBHs in a "local" binary would be a few to several hundred microarcseconds. A fraction of these may be accessible to ground-based very long baseline interferometric (VLBI) observations, but more distant or less massive binaries will require space-based VLBI observations. We report an on-going study to optimize the orbit of an orbiting radio antenna, observing in conjunction with an array of ground-based radio telescopes, for imaging of gravitational wave-emitting SMBH binaries. We describe both the optimization process and the subsequent injection and recovery imaging tests that we have conducted to illustrate the performance of the resulting ground+space VLBI array. This work was supported by Astrophysics Research & Analysis grant 80NSSC22K1747. The NANOGrav collaboration receives support from National Science Foundation (NSF) Physics Frontiers Center award Nos. 1430284 and 2020265, the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation, NSF AccelNet award No. 2114721, an NSERC Discovery Grant, and CIFAR. Part of this research was carried out at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology, under a contract with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. Some of this material is pre-decisional information and for planning and discussion only.

AI.abstract_translation: 北美纳赫兹引力波天文台（NANOGrav）及其他国际脉冲星计时阵列联盟已经提出了令人信服的证据，表明在纳赫兹频率存在一个随机引力波背景。基于星系并合以及超大质量黑洞（SMBHs）在星系中的可能占据份额的推测，人们预期会存在这样的随机引力波背景——随着星系并合，其中心的超大质量黑洞应当螺旋靠近，形成发射引力波的双星系统。然而，该随机引力波背景的振幅高于最初的预期，导致有观点认为随机引力波背景可能存在其他贡献来源，例如超出标准模型的物理或热大爆炸模型的扩展。如果SMBH双星是随机引力波背景的主要贡献者，那么应当存在一个半长轴为亚秒差距量级的"局域"SMBH双星群体。一个"局域"双星中SMBHs的预期角分离约为几到几百微角秒。其中一部分可能可供地基甚长基线干涉（VLBI）观测，但更遥远或质量更小的双星则需要天基VLBI观测。我们报告了一项正在进行的关于优化在轨射电天线轨道的研究，该天线与地基射电望远镜阵列联合观测，用于对发射引力波的SMBH双星进行成像。我们描述了优化过程以及随后进行的注入和恢复成像测试，以说明由此产生的地基+天基VLBI阵列的性能。这项工作得到了天体物理研究与分析项目80NSSC22K1747的支持。NANOGrav协作团队获得了美国国家科学基金会（NSF）物理前沿中心奖1430284号和2020265号、Gordon and Betty Moore基金会、NSF AccelNet奖2114721号、NSERC发现资助以及CIFAR的支持。这项研究的一部分是在加州理工学院喷气推进实验室进行的，该实验室与美国国家航空航天局签订有合同。本材料中的部分内容属于决策前信息，仅供规划与讨论之用。
AI.tldr: 本文报告一项正在进行的、关于优化在轨射电天线轨道以与地基射电望远镜阵列联合进行成像的研究，目标是对发射引力波的超大质量黑洞（SMBH）双星成像，并描述了优化过程及注入与恢复成像测试，以展示所形成的地基+天基VLBI阵列的性能。
AI.motivation: NANOGrav及其他国际脉冲星计时阵列联盟已给出纳赫兹随机引力波背景的证据，但其振幅高于最初预期，引发对其可能贡献来源的疑问。若SMBH双星为主要贡献者，则应存在"局域"SMBH双星群体，其角分离为几到几百微角秒，其中一些需要地基或天基VLBI观测。
AI.method: 摘要表明该研究为一项正在进行的研究：优化一个在轨射电天线的轨道，使其与地基射电望远镜阵列联合观测，用于对发射引力波的SMBH双星成像。作者描述了优化过程以及随后的注入和恢复成像测试，以说明由此产生的地基+天基VLBI阵列的性能。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间段、样本数量或数值参数。
AI.result: 摘要报告的背景结果是：NANOGrav及其他国际脉冲星计时阵列联盟给出了纳赫兹随机引力波背景的令人信服证据，且其振幅高于最初预期。摘要还指出，若SMBH双星为主要贡献者，应存在"局域"SMBH双星群体，其中一部分经地基VLBI可达，更遥远或质量更小的双星需天基VLBI。注入与恢复成像测试用于说明所得阵列性能，但摘要未给出具体性能数值。

title: The increasing family of the persistent Be X-ray binaries
summary: In the latest years the class of the persistent Be X-ray binaries (BeXRBs) has significantly increased, with the identification of several new sources of this type. The neutron stars (NSs) in these systems are among the slowest rotators in the X-ray sky (with P_ spin of hundreds to thousands of seconds) and are in a wide (P_ orb > 30 d) and almost circular orbit around a Be star; they accrete matter directly from the wind of the companion Be star, without the formation of an accretion disk. Due to the orbit and spin properties, the matter accretion occurs at a low and almost costant rate: therefore, these sources are characterized by persistent low X-ray luminosities, with L_ X∼ 10^34-35 erg s^-1. We report how the observation of these sources with various X-ray telescopes, in particular XMM-Newton, revealed that most of them are characterized by common timing and spectral properties. While the pulsed fraction does not vary with the photon energy, contrary to other classes of X-ray binaries, the source spectrum shows a significant excess above the main power-law component: in all cases it can be described with a hot (kT = 1-2 keV) and variable blackbody spectral component which contributes for 30-40 % to the total flux. Very interestingly, this thermal component has a size of a few hundreds meters, consistent with the estimated size of the NS polar cap. As an example, here we provide the results we have recently obtained with an XMM-Newton observation of the poorly known BeXRB 4U 0728-25, which allowed us to identify it as a persistent BeXRB. We show how, for these systems, NewAthena will offer a leap in sensitivity and spectral precision that current observatories cannot match. The high count statistics provided by its large collecting area will allow us to perform high-resolution timing analysis, tracking the pulse profile evolution to see how accretion "spots" change over time; moreover, with a detailed phase-resolved spectral analysis, it will be possible to investigate the variability of the thermal component along the pulse profile. Finally, thanks to the high-resolution spectroscopy enabled by the X-ray Integral Field Unit (X-IFU), it will be possible to resolve individual emission and absorption lines from the plasma as it falls toward the neutron star, and to map the velocity, density, and ionization state of the Be star's wind.

AI.abstract_translation: 近年来，持续型Be X射线双星（BeXRBs）这一类别显著增加，已识别出若干此类新源。这些系统中的中子星（NSs）是X射线天空中旋转最慢的天体之一（自旋周期 P_spin 为数百至数千秒），它们绕Be星运行在宽轨道（P_orb > 30 d）且近圆轨道上；它们直接从伴星Be星的风中吸积物质，而不形成吸积盘。由于轨道与自旋性质，物质吸积以低且近乎恒定的速率发生：因此，这些源以持续的低X射线光度为特征，其 L_X ∼ 10^34-35 erg s^-1。我们报告了如何利用各种X射线望远镜观测这些源，特别是XMM-Newton，其结果揭示其中大多数具有共同的计时与光谱性质。与其它类别的X射线双星不同，脉冲分数不随光子能量变化，而源光谱在主幂律成分之上显示出显著的超出：在所有情形下，该超出都可用一个热的（kT = 1-2 keV）且变化的黑体光谱成分来描述，其对总流量的贡献为30-40%。非常有趣的是，这一热成分的尺度为数百米量级，与NS极冠的估计尺度一致。作为示例，此处我们提供最近通过一次XMM-Newton观测所得的结果，该观测针对尚不为人知的BeXRB 4U 0728-25，使我们将其识别为持续型BeXRB。我们展示了对于这些系统，NewAthena将提供当前观测台无法匹敌的灵敏度与光谱精度跨越。其大收集面积所提供的高计数统计将使我们可以执行高分辨率计时分析，跟踪脉冲轮廓演化以观察吸积“斑点”如何随时间变化；此外，通过详细的相位分辨光谱分析，将有可能研究热成分沿脉冲轮廓的变化。最后，凭借由X射线积分场单元（X-IFU）实现的高分辨率光谱学，将有可能分辨等离子体落向中子星时产生的单个发射线与吸收线，并测绘Be星风的速率、密度与电离状态。
AI.tldr: 持续型Be X射线双星（BeXRBs）数量近年显著增加；其中大多数源的共同特征为、其光谱在主幂律成分之上存在一个热的（kT = 1-2 keV）、贡献30-40%总流量的可变黑体成分，其尺度约为数百米，与中子星极冠尺寸一致。作者还演示了XMM-Newton对4U 0728-25的观测将其识别为持续型源，并展望NewAthena将带来的能力提升。
AI.motivation: 近年来持续型Be X射线双星（BeXRBs）类别显著扩大并识别出若干新源。这些系统的中子星是X射线天空中旋转最慢的天体之一，且持续低光度吸积，但各源的共同计时与光谱性质此前尚不明确，因此需系统总结这些共性特征，并探究其物理成因及未来观测前景。
AI.method: 摘要未说明。作者报告利用多种X射线望远镜（特别是XMM-Newton）观测多组持续型BeXRB源，分析其计时与光谱性质，包括脉冲分数、主幂律成分之上的光谱超出，以及用黑体成分描述热辐射；并作为示例对未知源4U 0728-25进行了一次XMM-Newton观测。摘要未给出具体频率、时间跨度或样本数量。
AI.result: 持续型BeXRB系统的中子星自旋周期为数百至数千秒，轨道周期P_orb > 30 d且近圆，X射线光度为L_X ∼ 10^34-35 erg s^-1。与其它类X射线双星不同，其脉冲分数不随光子能量变化；光谱中存在热（kT = 1-2 keV）、变化、贡献30-40%总流量的黑体成分，尺度约数百米，与中子星极冠尺寸一致。XMM-Newton对4U 0728-25的观测将其识别为持续型BeXRB。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为这些源的共同计时与光谱性质（热黑体成分及其与极冠尺度的一致）表明其物理特征具有系统性意义。NewAthena凭借大收集面积和X-IFU高分辨率光谱学，有望进行高分辨率计时分析以跟踪脉冲轮廓演化，通过相位分辨光谱研究热成分变化，并分辨等离子体坠落时的谱线以测绘Be星风的速率、密度与电离状态。这些属于基于仪器能力的未来展望，依据摘要无法判断其成文观测结果。

title: Studies of Cosmic-Ray Accelerators with VERITAS
summary: The VERITAS (Very Energetic Radiation Imaging Telescope Array System) observatory continues to advance our understanding of cosmic-ray acceleration and propagation by providing TeV (E>0.1 TeV) gamma-ray observations of Galactic and extragalactic sources. With an angular resolution of < 0.1^∘ and excellent spectral sensitivity, VERITAS complements wide-field surveys such as LHAASO and HAWC, enabling detailed studies of candidate cosmic-ray accelerators in the TeV domain. Recent VERITAS results include deep observations of supernova remnants such as Tycho and Cassiopeia A, which reveal contrasting behaviors in particle acceleration efficiency, and also placing stringent limits on the TeV emission from SNR W44, bridging the gap between GeV and TeV measurements. Extended observations of the Cygnus region highlight collective particle acceleration in clusters of massive stars. Building on these studies, VERITAS has led multi-instrument follow-up campaigns targeting several PeV gamma-ray sources detected by LHAASO, including LHAASO J2108+5157 and LHAASO J0621+3755, MGRO J1908+06 and HESS J1857+026. Joint observations with HAWC, Fermi-LAT, and XMM-Newton have provided refined spectral and morphological constraints, revealing complex emission regions and, in the latter case, the first X-ray detection of PSR J0622+3749. The contribution from microquasars to the population of galactic cosmic rays will also be discussed in the context of the observed gamma-ray emission from SS 433. In coordination with LHAASO, HAWC, and Fermi, VERITAS continues to provide high-resolution TeV measurements essential to understanding the mechanisms powering the cosmic-ray accelerators in our Galaxy.

AI.abstract_translation: VERITAS（甚高能辐射成像望远镜阵列系统，Very Energetic Radiation Imaging Telescope Array System）观测站通过提供银河系内和银河系外源的TeV（E>0.1 TeV）伽马射线观测，继续推进我们对宇宙射线加速和传播的理解。凭借 < 0.1^∘ 的角分辨率和出色的能谱灵敏度，VERITAS 对 LHAASO 和 HAWC 等宽视场巡天形成互补，能够在 TeV 能段对候选宇宙射线加速器开展精细研究。VERITAS 近期的成果包括对诸如 Tycho 和 Cassiopeia A 等超新星遗迹的深度观测，这些观测揭示了粒子加速效率方面的对比性行为，同时也对 SNR W44 的 TeV 发射给出了严格的限制，从而弥合了 GeV 与 TeV 测量之间的差距。对天鹅座（Cygnus）区域的扩展观测凸显了大质量恒星团中的集体粒子加速。在这些研究的基础上，VERITAS 已主导针对 LHAASO 探测到的数个 PeV 伽马射线源的多仪器后随观测活动，这些源包括 LHAASO J2108+5157 和 LHAASO J0621+3755、MGRO J1908+06 以及 HESS J1857+026。与 HAWC、Fermi-LAT 和 XMM-Newton 的联合观测提供了更精细的能谱和形态学约束，揭示了复杂的发射区域，并在后一种情形中首次实现了对 PSR J0622+3749 的 X 射线探测。微类星体对银河系宇宙射线群体的贡献也将在 SS 433 所观测到的伽马射线发射背景下加以讨论。在与 LHAASO、HAWC 和 Fermi 的协同下，VERITAS 持续提供高分辨率的 TeV 测量，这对于理解驱动我们银河系中宇宙射线加速器的机制至关重要。
AI.tldr: VERITAS 利用 TeV（E>0.1 TeV）伽马射线观测研究宇宙射线加速器，其近期结果包括对超新星遗迹 Tycho 和 Cassiopeia A 的深度观测（揭示粒子加速效率呈现对比性行为）、对 SNR W44 的严格 TeV 上限，以及首次实现对 PSR J0622+3749 的 X 射线探测。

AI.method: 摘要说明 VERITAS 提供 E>0.1 TeV 的 TeV 伽马射线观测，角分辨率 < 0.1^∘，并开展深度的超新星遗迹观测、天鹅座区域扩展观测，以及与 HAWC、Fermi-LAT、XMM-Newton 的多仪器联合后随观测（针对 LHAASO J2108+5157、LHAASO J0621+3755、MGRO J1908+06、HESS J1857+026）。具体观测时段、能段细节摘要未说明。
AI.result: 深度观测揭示 Tycho 与 Cassiopeia A 在粒子加速效率方面呈现对比性行为；SNR W44 的 TeV 发射被给出严格限制；天鹅座区域扩展观测凸显大质量恒星团的集体粒子加速；联合观测提供了更精细的能谱和形态学约束，揭示复杂发射区域，并在 HESS J1857+026 情形中首次实现 PSR J0622+3749 的 X 射线探测。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为这些 TeV 高分辨率测量对于理解驱动银河系宇宙射线加速器的机制至关重要，并与 LHAASO、HAWC、Fermi 协同推进宇宙射线加速与传播研究。该工作涉及超新星遗迹、PeV 源与微类星体等加速器，但未涉及脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 的具体结论；相关转移性根据摘要无法判断。

title: The multiwavelength correlations quest for central engines of GRB plateaus: Magnetar vs black hole spin-down
summary: Gamma-ray burst lightcurves begin with a bright short phase called prompt and are followed by a long-lasting, shallow decay phase called a plateau. It was discovered that the luminosity at the end of the plateau is strongly anti-correlated with the duration of the plateau. Over the years, researchers have shown a few theoretical models which explain both the shape of lightcurves and the correlation. However, often those models struggle to reproduce the brightest events. Taking inspiration from the literature, we investigate a scenario where the initial star collapses into a black hole. During the prompt phase black hole is effectively accreating matter, thus gaining mass and spin. When the initial hyperaccretion changes into accretion by a magnetically arrested disk (MAD) the high magnetic field slows the accretion and due to turbulence the disk loses angular momentum. Simultaneously, the magnetic field is high enough to launch effective jets which are powered by the rotational energy of the black hole. This causes a black hole to lose angular momentum and creates a plateau-like shaped lightcurves. We demonstrate how this model reproduces the aforementioned correlation, and explain the cosmological evolution of the burst's parameters. Furthermore, within the presented model we discuss the clustering of short and long gamma-ray bursts in the studied parameter space.

AI.abstract_translation: 伽玛射线暴的光变曲线以明亮而短暂的阶段开始，称为瞬时相位，随后是持续较久的浅衰变阶段，称为平台。人们发现，平台结束时的光度与平台的持续时间之间存在很强的反相关关系。多年来，研究者们提出了几个理论模型，既能解释光变曲线的形状，也能解释这种相关关系。然而，这些模型常常难以重现最明亮的事件。受文献启发，我们研究了一种初始恒星坍缩成黑洞的情景。在瞬时相位期间，黑洞有效地吸积物质，从而获得质量和自旋。当初始的超临界吸积转变为由磁滞约束盘（MAD）进行的吸积时，高磁场减缓了吸积，并且由于湍流，吸积盘损失角动量。同时，磁场足够高，足以发射由黑洞转动能驱动的有效喷流。这导致黑洞损失角动量，并产生类平台状的光变曲线。我们展示了该模型如何重现上述相关关系，并解释了爆发参数随宇宙学演化的变化。此外，在该模型框架内，我们讨论了短伽玛射线暴和长伽玛射线暴在所研究的参数空间中的成团现象。
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由黑洞转动能驱动的伽玛射线暴平台模型：当超临界吸积转变为磁滞约束盘（MAD）吸积后，磁场减缓吸积并发射喷流，使黑洞丢失角动量，从而产生类平台光变曲线，重现了平台末端光度与持续时间之间的反相关关系，并解释了爆发参数的宇宙学演化以及长短暴的参数成团。
AI.motivation: 伽玛射线暴光变曲线中的平台阶段呈现出平台末端光度与持续时间强反相关的现象。现有理论模型虽能解释光变曲线形状和相关关系，却常难以重现最明亮的事件，因此需要探索能解释平台相及该关系的中心引擎模型。
AI.method: 摘要未说明观测数据、望远镜、频率或时间跨度。方法上，本文提出一种理论情景：初始恒星坍缩为黑洞，瞬时相位期间黑洞通过吸积获得质量与自旋；当超临界吸积转变为磁滞约束盘（MAD）吸积时，磁场减缓吸积、湍流使盘损失角动量，同时喷流由黑洞转动能驱动，使黑洞损失角动量并形成平台状光变曲线。
AI.result: 所提出模型能够重现平台末端光度与平台持续时间之间的强反相关关系，并解释伽玛射线暴参数随宇宙学演化的变化。此外，在该模型框架内还讨论了短伽玛射线暴与长伽玛射线暴在所研究参数空间中的成团现象。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出一种由黑洞转动能驱动的中心引擎情景，其中磁场通过磁滞约束盘（MAD）抑制吸积并驱动喷流，使黑洞损失角动量，从而产生平台状光变曲线并解释观测到的光度-时长反相关及短暴和长暴的参数成团。根据摘要无法判断。

title: The EMPI code for plasma-induced effects on radio waves. code implementation, and performance.
summary: Plasma-induced propagation effects on radio waves are ubiquitous in the universe, with magnetic fields playing an especially important role. To systematically compute how different plasma environments affect radio wave propagation, we have developed EMPI—a first-principles three-dimensional numerical framework for solving radio signal propagation problems in both magnetized and non-magnetized cold plasma. This paper, the new in the EMPI code series, presents a comprehensive account of its technical architecture and computational performance. We describe the parallel implementation strategies, numerical procedures, and physical processes handled by the code, including dispersion, Faraday rotation, lensing, scintillation, and scattering. Through systematic tests on benchmark problems, we validate the convergence and reliability of EMPI in high-precision numerical computations. Parallel performance tests show that the code scales efficiently to different model conditions. With the release of massive observational datasets from radio telescopes such as "The Second CHIME/FRB Catalog", EMPI serves as a valuable tool for studying the propagation effects among the data, helping to advance the understanding of their essence and the intervening plasma environments.

AI.abstract_translation: 等离子体引起的无线电线传播效应在宇宙中普遍存在，其中磁场扮演着尤其重要的角色。为了系统地计算不同等离子体环境如何影响无线电波的传播，我们开发了EMPI——一个用于求解磁化和非磁化冷等离子体中无线电信号传播问题的第一性原理三维数值框架。本文是EMPI代码系列中的新作，全面介绍了其技术架构和计算性能。我们描述了代码所采用的并行实现策略、数值流程以及所处理的物理过程，包括色散、法拉第旋转、透镜效应、闪烁和散射。通过对基准问题的系统性测试，我们验证了EMPI在高精度数值计算中的收敛性和可靠性。并行性能测试表明，该代码能够高效地扩展至不同的模型条件。随着来自射电望远镜（如"The Second CHIME/FRB Catalog"）的海量观测数据集的发布，EMPI成为研究这些数据中传播效应的宝贵工具，有助于加深对其本质和其间等离子体环境的理解。
AI.tldr: 该论文介绍EMPI代码，一个用于求解磁化和非磁化冷等离子体中无线电波传播问题的第一性原理三维数值框架，并全面报告其技术架构、并行实现和计算性能。基准测试验证了其收敛性与可靠性，据此认为该代码可成为研究大规模射电数据中传播效应的宝贵工具。
AI.motivation: 等离子体引起的无线电波传播效应在宇宙中普遍存在，磁场作用尤为重要，而不同等离子体环境对电波传播的影响需要系统地计算。为弥合这一问题，作者开发了第一性原理三维数值框架EMPI，并针对海量观测数据集（如The Second CHIME/FRB Catalog）中的传播效应研究提供数值工具。
AI.method: 摘要未说明具体观测数据或望远镜观测流程，说明为代码开发与性能验证论文。方法描述包括：构建求解磁化和非磁化冷等离子体中无线电信号传播问题的第一性原理三维数值框架EMPI；给出并行实现策略、数值流程及所处理物理过程（色散、法拉第旋转、透镜效应、闪烁、散射）；通过基准问题的系统性测试验证收敛性和可靠性，并进行并行性能测试。
AI.result: 报告显示，通过基准问题的系统性测试，EMPI在高精度数值计算中的收敛性和可靠性得到验证。并行性能测试表明该代码能高效扩展至不同的模型条件。摘要未给出具体数值结果、显著性水平或详细性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，随着射电望远镜（如The Second CHIME/FRB Catalog）海量观测数据集的发布，EMPI可作为研究其中传播效应的宝贵工具，有助于加深对传播效应本质及其间等离子体环境的理解。代码与FRB数据集的直接应用关系是由作者陈述的工具性意义，属于提倡用途；摘要未报告其在真实数据上的实际应用结果。

title: GRAINE: Results from the Analysis of the 2023 Australian Balloon Borne Experiment for Precision GeV/Sub GeV Cosmic Gamma Ray Observations with Nuclear Emulsion
summary: The observation of cosmic gamma rays is crucial for understanding high-energy astrophysical phenomena and cosmic-ray acceleration. Femi-LAT, launched in 2008, have observed the sub- GeV/GeV gamma-ray sky, and many new insights are obtained. Recent combined analysis using different wavelengths, gravitational waves and high-energy neutrinos makes the observation of cosmic gamma-rays even more significant. However, the results showed that the precise observation with high angular resolution is needed for making more progress in cosmic gamma-ray observation. GRAINE (Gamma-Ray Astro Imager with Nuclear Emulsion) is large-aperture-area observation project of cosmic gamma rays in the GeV/sub-GeV for precise by long balloon flights of the nuclear emulsion telescope. Nuclear emulsion is a charged particle detector with the highest spatial resolution based on the principle of silver halide photography. Due to the high spatial resolution (submicron) of the three-dimensional trajectory, the angular resolution of nuclear emulsion is close to the principle kinematical limit (0.1^∘ for 1 GeV gamma rays, 1.0^∘ for 100 MeV) and polarization information can also be provided as well. We have conducted the balloon experiments (2011, 2015, 2018) and succeeded in imaging the highest resolution of Vela Pulser during the 2018 Australian balloon experiment. As a next step, we developed a telescope with a larger aperture area (6.5 times larger than in 2018) to 2.5 m^2 and performed a balloon experiment in Australia in April 2023. Furthermore, the altitude of the flight was 35-37 km, the flight time was 23.5 hours, 1.6 times longer than in 2018, and it succeeded in covered only the Vela Pulser but also the galactic center. Through the analysis of the 2023 flight data, we confirmed that the imaging performance for the Vela pulsar with the enlarged telescope is comparable to that of the 2018 experiment. We also achieved a direct measurement of the flux within 1 degree of the Galactic Center. In this presentation, we report the latest status of the GRAINE experiment, including these results.

AI.abstract_translation: 宇宙伽马射线的观测对于理解高能天体物理现象和宇宙射线加速至关重要。2008年发射的Fermi-LAT已经观测了亚GeV/GeV伽马射线天空，并获得了许多新认识。近期结合不同波长、引力波和高能中微子的联合分析使宇宙伽马射线的观测更具重要意义。然而，结果表明，为在宇宙伽马射线观测上取得更大进展，需要具有高角分辨率的高精度观测。GRAINE（Gamma-Ray Astro Imager with Nuclear Emulsion）是一个利用核乳胶望远镜进行长航时气球飞行、对GeV/亚GeV宇宙伽马射线进行高精度观测的大孔径面积观测项目。核乳胶是一种基于卤化银照相原理、具有最高空间分辨率的带电粒子探测器。凭借三维径迹的高空间分辨率（亚微米），核乳胶的角分辨率接近原理运动学极限（对1 GeV伽马射线为0.1°，对100 MeV为1.0°），并且同样能提供偏振信息。我们已进行了气球实验（2011、2015、2018），并在2018年澳大利亚气球实验中成功成像了角分辨率最高的Vela脉冲星。作为下一步，我们研制了一台孔径面积更大的望远镜（比2018年大6.5倍），达到2.5 m²，并于2023年4月在澳大利亚进行了一次气球实验。此外，飞行高度为35-37 km，飞行时间为23.5小时，比2018年长1.6倍，并且不仅成功覆盖了Vela脉冲星，还覆盖了银河系中心。通过对2023年飞行数据的分析，我们确认了使用扩大望远镜对Vela脉冲星的成像性能与2018年实验相当。我们还实现了对银河系中心1度范围内通量的直接测量。在本报告中，我们介绍GRAINE实验的最新状态，包括这些结果。
AI.tldr: GRAINE气球实验在2023年4月澳大利亚飞行中，用孔径面积扩大至2.5 m²的核乳胶望远镜观测了Vela脉冲星与银河系中心，确认其成像性能与2018年相当，并实现了对银河系中心1度范围内通量的直接测量。
AI.motivation: 为推进宇宙伽马射线观测，需要具备高角分辨率的高精度观测以弥补现有手段（如Fermi-LAT）的局限。GRAINE利用核乳胶望远镜的高空间分辨率（角分辨率接近原理运动学极限）开展GeV/亚GeV宇宙伽马射线观测，并扩大孔径面积进行新一轮气球实验。
AI.method: 摘要说明了GRAINE项目利用核乳胶望远镜在澳大利亚进行2023年4月气球实验，孔径面积扩大至2.5 m²（为2018年的6.5倍），飞行高度35-37 km，飞行时间23.5小时（比2018年长1.6倍），覆盖Vela脉冲星与银河系中心，并对飞行数据进行成像与通量分析。此前已有2011、2015、2018年实验。
AI.result: 通过2023年飞行数据分析，确认扩大望远镜对Vela脉冲星的成像性能与2018年实验相当；并实现了对银河系中心1度范围内通量的直接测量。
AI.conclusion: 作者根据2023年数据分析得出结论：放大孔径的核乳胶望远镜保持了与2018年相当的Vela脉冲星成像性能，并能直接测量银河系中心1度内的通量，表明GRAINE在GeV/亚GeV高角分辨率伽马射线观测方面取得进展。由于摘要未涉及脉冲星计时、模式转换、偏振或FRB等内容，对这类源的转移意义根据摘要无法判断。

title: The MoonIS instrument on board the Rashid 3 Rover
summary: The Rashid Rover 3 is part of the Emirates Lunar Mission program of the Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC). The program includes the development and launch of the series of "Rashid" lunar rovers. MoonIS is a VIS─IR spectrometer hosted on the third rover, that will explore the lunar South Pole region. MoonIS is designed to collect hyperspectral data of the lunar surface in the range between about 0.4 and 2.3 μm. The instrument builds on the heritage of the Ma_MISS spectrometer [1] aboard ESA ExoMars Rosalind Franklin (RF) rover, but introduces notable modifications to the optical head, calibration target, thermomechanical structure, and electronics. Unlike the Ma_MISS Optical Head (OH), which is integrated into the RF rover's drill tip, the MoonIS OH will be mounted on the Rashid rover mast and connected via optical fibers to the spectrometer housed within the rover body. In its current design, MoonIS simultaneously collects three spectra from three different "spots" on the ground. By exploiting the mast movement, MoonIS can acquire more spectra scanning a broader region of interest. The primary scientific objective of the mission payload is the identification and characterization of lunar water ice. Thanks to its spectral performances and imaging capabilities enabled by mast scanning, MoonIS will acquire high quality spectral data of selected targets, allowing the detection, mapping, and analysis of water ice where present, as well as the characterization of surface mineralogy at the lunar South Pole. PSRs on the Moon and on other Solar System bodies act as cold traps where water ice and other volatiles accumulate. Lunar PSRs are expected to host significant quantities of water ice, crucial for future human lunar exploration [2─4]. However, fine scale geomorphology and ice distribution within PSRs remain poorly constrained because orbital datasets currently lack sufficient spatial resolution or signal. Moreover, it is still not clear how much water ice on the Moon is exposed, since from a morphological point of view, the regions where ice is predicted do not exhibit the expected morphological features [5]. In situ exploration of PSR to investigate water ice is therefore a primary goal of modern lunar science and a key driver of multiple ongoing and planned missions. Acknowledgments: This work is supported by Accordo ASI ─ INAF n. 2024-64-HH.0. The instrument is funded by ASI and manufactured by Leonardo S.p.A. (Italy). References: [1] De Sanctis et al. (2017), Astrobiology 17, 6, 7. [2] McCubbin et al. (2015), American Mineralogist 100: 1668-1707. [3] Honniball et al. (2021), Nature Astronomy 5: 121-127. [4] Pieters et al. (2009) Science, 326, 568─572. [5] Mahanti et al., (2023), . J. Astron. Space Sci.;40(4):131-148.

AI.abstract_translation: Rashid 3 月球车是穆罕默德·本·拉希德航天中心（MBRSC）阿联酋月球任务计划的一部分。该计划包括一系列“Rashid”月球车的研制与发射。MoonIS 是搭载于第三辆月球车上的一台 VIS─IR 光谱仪，将探索月球南极区域。MoonIS 旨在采集月球表面约 0.4 至 2.3 μm 范围内的超光谱数据。该仪器继承了 ESA ExoMars Rosalind Franklin（RF）月球车上 Ma_MISS 光谱仪 [1] 的技术传统，但对光学头、定标目标、热机械结构和电子学进行了显著改进。与集成在 RF 月球车钻头尖端内的 Ma_MISS 光学头（OH）不同，MoonIS 光学头将安装在 Rashid 月球车的桅杆上，并通过光纤连接到置于月球车车体内的光谱仪。在目前的设计中，MoonIS 同时从地面的三个不同“光斑”采集三条光谱。通过利用桅杆的运动，MoonIS 可以扫描更广泛的感兴趣区域，采集更多光谱。该任务有效载荷的主要科学目标是识别和表征月球水冰。凭借其光谱性能以及由桅杆扫描实现的成像能力，MoonIS 将采集选定目标的高质量光谱数据，从而在存在水冰之处实现对水冰的探测、测绘和分析，以及对月球南极表面矿物学的表征。月球以及其他太阳系天体上的 PSR 充当冷阱，水冰和其他挥发物在此积聚。预计月球 PSR 中含有大量水冰，这对未来人类月球探索至关重要 [2─4]。然而，PSR 内部的精细尺度地貌和水冰分布仍缺乏充分约束，因为现有轨道数据集缺乏足够的空间分辨率或信号。此外，月球上究竟有多少水冰是暴露的仍不清楚，因为从形态学角度看，预测存在冰的区域并未表现出预期的形态特征 [5]。对 PSR 的原位探索以研究水冰，因此是现代月球科学的首要目标，也是多项进行中及规划中任务的关键驱动因素。致谢：本工作得到 Accordo ASI ─ INAF n. 2024-64-HH.0 的支持。该仪器由 ASI 资助，由 Leonardo S.p.A.（意大利）制造。参考文献：[1] De Sanctis et al. (2017), Astrobiology 17, 6, 7. [2] McCubbin et al. (2015), American Mineralogist 100: 1668-1707. [3] Honniball et al. (2021), Nature Astronomy 5: 121-127. [4] Pieters et al. (2009) Science, 326, 568─572. [5] Mahanti et al., (2023), . J. Astron. Space Sci.;40(4):131-148.
AI.tldr: 介绍搭载于 Rashid 3 月球车上的 MoonIS VIS─IR 光谱仪仪器设计，其旨在采集 0.4–2.3 μm 月球表面超光谱数据，主要科学目标是探测、测绘与分析月球南极水冰以及表征表面矿物学。
AI.motivation: 文章指出 PSR 是水冰等挥发物聚集的冷阱，预计月球 PSR 含有大量水冰，对未来的载人月球探测至关重要；然而 PSR 内精细尺度地貌和冰分布因轨道数据分辨率或信号不足而尚不明确，且暴露水冰量仍不清楚，因此需要对 PSR 进行原位探测。
AI.method: 摘要描述了 MoonIS 仪器设计：继承 Ma_MISS 光谱仪技术，光学头装在月球车桅杆上并经光纤连接至车体内的光谱仪；同时从地面三个光斑采集三条光谱，并利用桅杆运动扫描更广区域，采集 0.4–2.3 μm 范围超光谱数据。摘要未说明。
AI.result: MoonIS 将采集选定目标的高质量光谱数据，从而实现在存在水冰之处探测、测绘和分析水冰，并表征月球南极的表面矿物学；同时利用三个光谱与桅杆扫描获得的成像能力获取所选区域的多条光谱。摘要未说明。
AI.conclusion: 作者将识别和表征月球水冰作为任务的主要科学目标，并指出通过其光谱性能与桅杆扫描的成像能力可实现对水冰和矿物学的探测与表征，以支撑对 PSR 水冰的原位研究。根据摘要无法判断。

title: NewAthena Opportunities in Transient and Multi-messenger Domain
summary: With an unprecedented combination of collecting area, survey capabilities and energy resolution, NewAthena will open a new window in the transient and multi-messenger domain in the 2030s and 2040s. The 2040s hold strong potential to see exciting opportunities for joint study between NewAthena and future Gravitational detector LISA to jointly probe merging supermassive black holes. The same era will likely see a global network of powerful neutrino detectors including IceCube, P-ONE, KM3Net, PLEvM-1, that can join NewAthena's study of extreme cosmic particle accelerators like blazers, Serfert galaxies, micro-quasars and pulsar wind nebula, etc. This talk will overview NewAthena's unique science cases in the synergy with near-future neutrino detectors and gravitational wave detectors.

AI.abstract_translation: 凭借前所未有的集光面积、巡天能力和能量分辨率的组合，NewAthena将在2030年代和2040年代在瞬变与多信使领域打开一扇新的窗口。2040年代具有很强的潜力，可以看到NewAthena与未来的引力波探测器LISA之间进行联合研究的有趣机会，以共同探测并合的超大质量黑洞。同一时期很可能将出现一个包括IceCube、P-ONE、KM3Net、PLEvM-1在内的强大中微子探测器全球网络，它们可以加入NewAthena对极端宇宙粒子加速器（如耀变体、塞弗特星系、微类星体和脉冲星风云等）的研究。本次报告将综述NewAthena在与近期中微子探测器和引力波探测器协同方面的独特科学案例。

title: Expanding the population of short gamma-ray transients with a coherent fermi/GBM search: a 13-yr catalogue of short GRBs
summary: In this paper, we present an archival search for short gamma-ray bursts (sGRBs) over 13 yr (2013--2025) of Fermi/GBM (Gamma-ray Burst Monitor) data using a Poisson matched-filter pipeline that performs a fully coherent analysis across all detectors and energy channels, significantly improving sensitivity relative to the onboard triggering algorithms. A central component of the analysis is the empirical estimation of trigger significance using `timeslided' data, allowing each candidate to be assigned a probability of astrophysical origin. We also developed a new parameter-estimation framework based on the Poisson matched filter, which uses the global structure of the detected event across spectral, temporal, and spatial parameter spaces. This enables us to systematically classify bursts and distinguish between GRBs, soft gamma repeaters, terrestrial gamma-ray flashes, and solar flares. We identify 549 new GRB candidates with high confidence and thousands of magnetar bursts, significantly expanding the known short transient population in GBM data. To further strengthen the significance of the GRB candidates, we performed a targeted follow-up search in Swift/BAT rate data. Applying the follow-up to all of our triggers -- including triggers below the detection threshold yielded 1736 temporally coincident events with association probability above 90 per cent. The resulting probabilistically ranked catalogue substantially expands the population of short transients detected in GBM data and provides a statistically robust framework for multimessenger searches.
journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

AI.abstract_translation: 在本文中，我们利用一种泊松匹配滤波器流水线，对13年（2013–2025年）的Fermi/GBM（伽马射线暴监视器）数据进行了短伽马射线暴（sGRBs）的档案搜索。该流水线在所有探测器和能量通道上进行完全相干分析，相比星上触发算法显著提高了灵敏度。该分析的一个核心组成部分是使用'timeslided'数据对触发显著性进行经验估计，从而使每个候选事件都能被赋予一个天体物理起源概率。我们还开发了一个基于泊松匹配滤波器的新型参数估计框架，该框架利用在光谱、时间与空间参数空间中探测事件的整体结构。这使我们能够系统地分类暴发现象，并区分伽马射线暴、软伽马射线再现源、地球伽马射线闪和太阳耀斑。我们以高置信度识别出549个新的GRB候选事件以及数以千计磁星暴发，显著扩大了GBM数据中已知的短暂现源群体。为进一步增强GRB候选事件的显著性，我们在Swift/BAT计数率数据中进行了有针对性的后续搜索。将后续搜索应用于我们所有的触发事件——包括低于探测阈值的触发事件——得到1736个时间重合事件，其关联概率高于90%。由此得到的概率排序型目录显著扩大了GBM数据中探测到的短暂现源群体，并为多信使搜索提供了统计上稳健的框架。
AI.tldr: 作者利用泊松匹配滤波器对Fermi/GBM 13年（2013–2025）数据进行了完全相干档案搜索，以高置信度识别出549个新的GRB候选事件和数以千计的磁星暴发，并经Swift/BAT后续搜索得到1736个关联概率高于90%的时间重合事件，显著扩大了短暂现源目录。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过更灵敏的完全相干搜索算法，系统发现并分类短伽马射线暴等其他短暂现源，扩大Fermi/GBM数据中已知短暂现源群体，并为多信使搜索提供统计上稳健的目录框架。
AI.method: 对2013–2025年共13年的Fermi/GBM数据，使用泊松匹配滤波器流水线进行跨所有探测器和能量通道的完全相干分析；用timeslided数据经验估计触发显著性并赋予天体物理起源概率；采用基于泊松匹配滤波器的参数估计框架，结合光谱、时间与空间特性对GRB、软伽马射线再现源、地球伽马射线闪和太阳耀斑进行分类；并在Swift/BAT计数率数据中进行有针对性的后续搜索。
AI.result: 以高置信度识别出549个新的GRB候选事件及数千个磁星暴发；将后续搜索应用于包括低于探测阈值在内的全部触发事件后，得到1736个关联概率高于90%的时间重合事件。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出的概率排序目录显著扩大了GBM数据中短暂现源群体，并提供了一个统计上稳健的多信使搜索框架。摘要未讨论与脉冲星、磁星及FRB关联的物理解释；磁星暴发仅作为分类识别产物被提及，未作进一步解释。

title: LHAASO J1849-0002: A hybrid lepto-hadronic interpretation of PeV γ-ray emission
summary: Recently, LHAASO detected γ-ray emission from the pulsar wind nebula (PWN) J1849-0001 extending up to approximately 2 PeV, providing strong evidence for petaelectronvolt (PeV) particle acceleration. To explain the origin of this ultrahigh-energy emission, we investigated three physical scenarios: a pure leptonic model, a hadronic-dominated model, and a hybrid lepto-hadronic model. We show that while both pure leptonic and hadronic-dominated models can reproduce parts of the multiwavelength spectral energy distribution, neither can simultaneously explain the entire dataset, particularly the PeV tail. The leptonic scenario requires an unrealistically high electron cutoff energy, while the hadronic model underpredicts the highest-energy emission. We therefore propose a hybrid model that combines inverse Compton emission from PWN electrons with hadronic interactions between escaped cosmic rays and a nearby molecular cloud. In this framework, a suppressed diffusion coefficient (~1% of the Galactic average) is required to confine PeV particles in the source vicinity. This model successfully reproduces the full SED, including the approximately 2 PeV emission. We further calculated the associated neutrino flux and show the sensitivity of NEON to this source. Our results support the interpretation that evolved PWNe embedded in complex environments can act as Galactic PeVatrons.

AI.abstract_translation: 最近，LHAASO探测到来自脉冲星风云（PWN）J1849-0001的γ射线发射，其能量延伸至约2 PeV，为PeV（拍电子伏）粒子加速提供了强有力的证据。为解释这一超高能发射的起源，我们研究了三种物理情景：纯轻子模型、强子主导模型以及轻子-强子混合模型。我们表明，尽管纯轻子模型和强子主导模型都能重现多波段能谱分布的部分特征，但两者均无法同时解释整个数据集，尤其是PeV尾端。轻子情景需要不切实际地高的电子截断能量，而强子模型则低估了最高能发射。因此，我们提出一种混合模型，将来自PWN电子的逆康普顿发射与逃逸宇宙射线与邻近分子云之间的强子相互作用相结合。在该框架下，需要抑制的扩散系数（约为银河平均值的1%）来将PeV粒子限制在源附近。该模型成功重现了完整的能谱分布（SED），包括约2 PeV的发射。我们进一步计算了相关的微中子通量，并展示了NEON对该源的灵敏度。我们的结果支持这样的解释：嵌入在复杂环境中的演化PWN可以充当银河系PeV加速源（PeVatrons）。
AI.tldr: 本文针对LHAASO在PWN J1849-0001探测到的约2 PeV γ射线发射，提出混合轻子-强子模型：将PWN电子的逆康普顿发射与逃逸宇宙射线和邻近分子云的强子相互作用结合，能够重现完整多波段能谱分布（SED），支持演化PWN可作为银河系PeVatrons的观点。
AI.motivation: LHAASO探测到来自脉冲星风云J1849-0001的γ射线发射延伸至约2 PeV，为PeV粒子加速提供了强有力证据。需要解释这一超高能发射的起源，但纯轻子模型要求不切实际的高电子截断能量，强子模型则低估最高能发射，均无法同时解释整个数据集。
AI.method: 对PWN J1849-0001的约2 PeV γ射线发射研究了三种物理模型——纯轻子模型、强子主导模型和轻子-强子混合模型，并用以重现多波段能谱分布（SED）。混合模型中结合PWN电子的逆康普顿发射与逃逸宇宙射线和邻近分子云的强子相互作用，并采用受抑制的扩散系数（约为银河平均值1%），此外还计算了相关微中子通量及NEON灵敏度。
AI.result: 研究表明，纯轻子模型和强子主导模型均可重现多波段能谱分布的部分特征，但均无法同时解释整个数据集，尤其是PeV尾端；轻子情景需要不切实际地高的电子截断能量，强子模型则低估最高能发射。提出的混合模型在扩散系数约为银河平均值1%的框架下成功重现了完整SED（含约2 PeV发射），并计算了相关微中子通量及NEON对该源的灵敏度。
AI.conclusion: 作者明确支持嵌入复杂环境中的演化PWN可以充当银河系PeVatrons的物理解释，即通过轻子（逆康普顿）与强子（逃逸宇宙射线与分子云相互作用）的混合机制解释LHAASO观测到的约2 PeV γ射线发射及其微中子关联。该结果对脉冲星风云、粒子加速及可能的高能中微子源研究具有意义。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、脉冲星计时或FRB的适用性。

title: Time-resolved Spectroscopic study of Ultra-long GRB 220627A
summary: Ultra-long GRB 220627A, detected by Fermi on June 27, 2022, challenges collapsar models with two bright prompt episodes separated by 600 s quiescence. We present time-resolved spectroscopy and flux variability using Fermi gamma-ray burst monitor data, showing Comptonized power-law spectra evolving hard-to-soft across episodes. Minimum variability timescales trace compact dissipation in a relativistic jet. Bayesian Blocks and HOP algorithms define adaptive time bins for precise spectral tracking. Fermi Large Area Telescope analysis confirms GeV emission exclusively during the first episode (TS = 192; maximum 15.7 GeV photon), ruling out afterglow origin. Systematic comparisons with GRB 091024A (magnetar candidate) and GRB 130925A (blue supergiant (BSG) confirmed) position GRB 220627A in the high-isotropic equivalent energy, multi-episode regime of a BSG collapsar. Transient thermal components (CPL and black-body fits, kT 22─31 keV) during peak flares indicate jet-cocoon photospheric emission at radii matching minimum variability timescales, unique to BSG progenitors with extended hydrogen envelopes. Cross-correlation function and power spectral density evolution analyses, plus absent GeV in Episode II, exclude lensing, confirming a single ultra-long event. Prolonged quiescence implies fallback accretion sustaining the jet; flares trace mass supply variations. This establishes fallback as key for ultra-long prompt emission, revealing jet dynamics and central engine longevity in BSG collapsars.

AI.abstract_translation: 由Fermi于2022年6月27日探测到的超长伽马射线暴GRB 220627A，以两个相距600秒静止期的明亮瞬时暴发脉冲对塌缩星（collapsar）模型提出挑战。我们利用Fermi伽马射线暴监测仪数据开展时间分辨光谱学和流量变化性研究，显示康普顿化幂律谱在各暴发脉冲之间呈由硬到软（hard-to-soft）演化。最小变化时标刻画了相对论性喷流中的致密耗散。Bayesian Blocks和HOP算法用于定义自适应时间bin以实现精确的光谱追踪。Fermi大面积望远镜（Large Area Telescope）分析证实高能（GeV）发射仅出现在第一个脉冲期间（TS = 192；最大能量15.7 GeV光子），排除了余辉起源。与GRB 091024A（磁星候选体）和GRB 130925A（蓝超巨星（BSG）已确认）的系统性比较，将GRB 220627A定位于BSG塌缩星的高各向同性等效能量、多脉冲爆发区间。峰值耀发期间的瞬态热成分（CPL和黑体拟合，kT 22─31 keV）表明喷流-茧（jet-cocoon）光球发射，其半径与最小变化时标相匹配，这对具有延展氢包层的BSG前身星是独特的。互相关函数和功率谱密度演化分析，加上Episode II中GeV辐射缺失，排除了引力透镜效应，确认其为一个单一的极长事件。延长的静止期暗示回降吸积（fallback accretion）维持喷流；耀发则示踪质量供应变化。这确立了回降（fallback）作为超长瞬时发射的关键机制，揭示了BSG塌缩星中的喷流动力学和中心引擎长寿性。
AI.tldr: 对超长伽马射线暴GRB 220627A的时间分辨光谱和流量变化性分析显示，其瞬时辐射符合BSG塌缩星模型中由回降吸积（fallback accretion）维系的喷流，且GeV发射仅出现在第一脉冲，排除了余辉和引力透镜起源。
AI.motivation: 超长GRB 220627A以两个相隔600秒静止期的明亮瞬时暴发脉冲对塌缩星模型构成挑战，需通过时间分辨光谱、GeV分析与系统比较明确其物理起源并检验回降吸积作为超长瞬时发射关键机制的作用。
AI.method: 利用Fermi伽马射线暴监测仪数据进行时间分辨光谱学和流量变化性分析；采用Bayesian Blocks和HOP算法定义自适应时间bin以追踪光谱演化；使用Fermi大面积望远镜（Large Area Telescope）分析GeV发射（TS=192）；并与GRB 091024A和GRB 130925A进行系统性比较；还进行了互相关函数与功率谱密度演化分析。
AI.result: 光谱呈康普顿化幂律并由硬到软演化；最小变化时标示踪致密耗散；GeV发射仅存在于第一脉冲（TS=192，最大15.7 GeV光子），排除余辉起源；GRB 220627A位于BSG塌缩星的高各向同性等效能量、多脉冲区间；峰值耀发含瞬态热成分（CPL与黑体拟合，kT 22─31 keV）；互相关与功率谱分析及第二脉冲GeV缺失排除引力透镜，确认单一超长事件。
AI.conclusion: 作者推断热成分源自喷流-茧光球发射，其半径与最小变化时标匹配，对带有延展氢包层的BSG前身星独特；延长静止期暗示回降吸积维系喷流，耀发示踪质量供应变化，从而确立回降作为超长瞬时发射的关键机制，揭示了BSG塌缩星的喷流动力学与中心引擎长寿性。根据摘要无法判断。

title: The Gamma-ray Transients Monitor (GTM) and Gamma-ray Polarimeter and Monitor (GPM) on board Formosat-8B and -8D
summary: The Gamma-ray Transients Monitor (GTM) is a science payload of Formosat-8B (FS-8B) for monitoring Gamma Ray Bursts (GRBs) and other transients, such as magnetar bursts and solar flares, in the energy band from 50 keV to 2 MeV. GTM consists of two identical modules located on two opposite sides of FS-8B, a Taiwanese remote sensing satellite. Each module has four sensor units facing different directions to cover half of the sky. The two modules will then cover the whole sky, including the direction occulted by the Earth. Each sensor unit is composed of a GAGG scintillator array (50 mm × 50 mm × 8 mm) to be readout by SiPM with 16 pixel-channels. Based on different flux levels detected by different sensor units, the direction of the GRB event can be determined. GTM will enhance the sky coverage of contemporary missions and provide independent event localization measurement. Spectral analysis and polarization-state determination for bright GRBs can be conducted with GTM data. GTM is expected to detect about 50 GRBs per year. The GTM flight model has been integrated to FS-8B satellite bus. The launch is expected in late 2026. The Gamma-ray Polarimeter and Monitor (GPM) is a similar instrument to fly on FS-8D. Different from GTM, there are 6 sensor units in each GPM module, which form a cube to enhance polarization measurement capability by catching more Compton events. GPM flight model delivery to TASA is expected in September 2027. FS-8D is scheduled to launch in late 2028. When operating together, GTM and GPM can boost localization performance with the method of arrival time difference.

AI.abstract_translation: 伽马射线瞬变监测器（GTM）是福尔摩沙卫星8B（FS-8B）的科学有效载荷，用于在50 keV至2 MeV能量范围内监测伽马射线暴（GRB）以及其他瞬变事件，例如磁星暴发和太阳耀斑。GTM由两个相同的模块组成，分别位于FS-8B（台湾的一颗遥感卫星）的相反两侧。每个模块有四个朝向不同方向的传感器单元，以覆盖一半的天空。两个模块随后将覆盖整个天空，包括被地球掩蔽的方向。每个传感器单元由一个GAGG闪烁体阵列（50 mm × 50 mm × 8 mm）组成，由具有16像素通道的SiPM读出。基于不同传感器单元检测到的不同通量水平，可以确定GRB事件的方向。GTM将增强当代任务的天空覆盖范围，并提供独立的事件定位测量。可利用GTM数据进行亮GRB的光谱分析和偏振态测定。GTM预计每年探测约50个GRB。GTM飞行模型已集成到FS-8B卫星平台。发射预计在2026年底。伽马射线偏振计与监测器（GPM）是一种类似的仪器，将搭载于FS-8D。与GTM不同，每个GPM模块中有6个传感器单元，这些单元构成一个立方体，通过捕捉更多康普顿事件来增强偏振测量能力。GPM飞行模型交付给TASA预计在2027年9月。FS-8D计划于2028年底发射。当GTM和GPM联合运行时，可以通过到达时间差的方法提升定位性能。

title: Evolving Accretion Flows: Insights from Polarization Angle Variations in X-ray Binaries
summary: Polarimetry offers a powerful probe of accretion flow evolution, breaking degeneracies that spectral and timing analyses alone cannot resolve. Notably, X-ray binaries exhibit unexpected polarization angle variations: rapid hour-to-day swings in several sources, remarkable constancy across QPO phases in a black hole binary, and anomalous pulse-phase dependencies in accreting X-ray pulsars. These diverse patterns encode the geometry and dynamics of evolving accretion flows. This talk reviews key observational results, discusses the accretion physics revealed by these polarization signatures, and outlines the potential of the upcoming eXTP mission.

title: Magnetic field generation in mergers of massive main-sequence stars
summary: Magnetic fields are found in many astrophysical objects, ranging from galaxy clusters to the interstellar medium of galaxies and neutron stars. Strong surface magnetic fields are also observed in about 7% of OBA-type stars, and stellar mergers are the likely origin of at least some of them. We investigated magnetic-field amplification during the merger of a 9 and an 8 M<SUB>⊙</SUB> main-sequence star using 3D magnetohydrodynamic simulations from our previous work. We focused on the magnetic-field amplification mechanisms, field geometry, and the structure and properties of the resulting merger, in particular its rotational configuration. The merger produces a star--torus structure in which the core of the initially less massive star is surrounded by material from the primary. The torus contains ≈3 M<SUB>⊙</SUB> and stores about 60% of the initial orbital angular momentum, and dynamic mass loss is negligible. Initially, turbulent motions driven by Kelvin--Helmholtz and magneto-rotational instabilities generate small-scale (≈0.1 R<SUB>⊙</SUB>) magnetic fields. Subsequently, large-scale ordered azimuthal flows drive a larger-scale dynamo that amplifies and redistributes the magnetic energy to larger spatial scales (≈5 R<SUB>⊙</SUB>), producing a remnant threaded by a strong large-scale magnetic field. The final magnetic configuration consists of intertwined poloidal and toroidal components, with a residual small-scale structure that resembles previously identified stable magnetic field equilibria. The amplification process is largely insensitive to the initial binary separation, numerical resolution, and seed magnetic-field strength, indicating that the final field loses memory of the initial magnetic conditions. The central regions of the merger remnant rapidly approach solid-body rotation, transitioning to a Keplerian-like profile within the surrounding torus. Our results support stellar mergers as a viable pathway for the formation of strongly magnetic massive stars and potentially highly magnetized compact remnants, such as magnetic white dwarfs and magnetars.

AI.abstract_translation: 在许多天体物理天体中都能找到磁场，范围从星系团到星系的星际介质以及中子星。在约7%的OBA型恒星中也观测到了较强的表面磁场，而恒星并合很可能是其中至少一部分磁场的起源。我们利用先前工作中的三维磁流体动力学模拟，研究了9 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>与8 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>主序恒星并合过程中的磁场放大。我们聚焦于磁场放大机制、磁场几何结构，以及并合所形成的天体的结构与性质，尤其是其转动结构。并合产生了一个恒星–环状（star–torus）结构，其中初始质量较小恒星的核心被主星（primary）抛出的物质所包围。该环状结构含有约3 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>，储存了初始轨道角动量的约60%，且动态质量损失可以忽略。最初，由开尔文–亥姆霍兹不稳定性与磁转动不稳定性驱动的湍流运动产生了小尺度（约0.1 R<SUB>⊙</SUB>）的磁场。随后，大尺度的有序环向流动驱动了更大尺度的发电机过程，该过程放大了磁能并将其重新分布到更大的空间尺度（约5 R<SUB>⊙</SUB>），从而产生了一个贯穿有强的大尺度磁场的残骸。最终的磁场结构包含交织的极向与环向分量，并带有残余的小尺度结构，该结构与先前识别出的稳定磁场平衡态相似。放大过程对初始双星间距、数值分辨率以及种子磁场的强度在很大程度上不敏感，这表明最终的磁场失去了对初始磁场条件的记忆。并合残骸的中心区域迅速趋近刚体转动，在其周围环状结构内转变为类似开普勒的分布。我们的结果支持恒星并合作为形成强磁大质量恒星以及可能高度磁化的致密残骸（如磁白矮星和磁星）的可行途径。
AI.tldr: 通过三维磁流体动力学模拟，作者研究了9 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>与8 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>主序恒星并合中的磁场放大，结果表明并合产生恒星–环状结构，并通过发电机机制形成强的大尺度磁场，支持恒星并合是强磁恒星及潜在磁化致密残骸（包括磁星）的可行形成途径。
AI.motivation: 约7%的OBA型恒星观测到强表面磁场，而恒星并合被认为是其中至少一部分磁场的可能起源。本文旨在通过并合模拟研究磁场放大机制、磁场几何结构以及并合产物的结构与性质，特别是其转动构型，以检验恒星并合能否形成强磁性的恒星与致密残骸。
AI.method: 方法基于作者先前工作中的三维磁流体动力学（3D MHD）模拟，研究对象为9 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>与8 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>主序恒星的并合。分析聚焦磁场放大机制、磁场几何、并合结构的性质与转动构型，并考察放大过程对初始双星间距、数值分辨率及种子磁场强度的敏感性。摘要未说明具体观测数据或望远镜。
AI.result: 并合产生恒星–环状结构，最初质量较低的恒星核心被主星物质包围；环状结构含约3 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>并储存初始轨道角动量的约60%，动态质量损失可忽略。开尔文–亥姆霍兹与磁转动不稳定性驱动的湍流先产生约0.1 R<SUB>⊙</SUB>的小尺度磁场，随后大尺度环向流驱动的发电机将磁能放大并重分布至约5 R<SUB>⊙</SUB>，形成强的残骸大尺度磁场。最终磁结构含交织的极向与环向分量及残余小尺度结构。放大过程对初始间距、数值分辨率及种子磁场强度基本不敏感；残骸中心迅速趋近刚体转动，并在环带内转变为类开普勒分布。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为结果支持恒星并合是形成强磁大质量恒星以及潜在的高磁化致密残骸（如磁白矮星和磁星）的可行途径。摘要明确提及磁星作为可能产物，但未涉及其与快速射电暴（FRB）的直接关联。根据摘要无法判断该方法在其他天体物理场景的转移性。

title: IXPE science highlights: Galactic sources
summary: I will review some of IXPE's many science highlights centered on Galactic sources. IXPE has produced a rich array of highly impactful science from observing Galactic sources. For example, it has significantly impacted our understanding of black hole X-ray binary systems. Observations of the polarisation aligning with the radio jet indicate that the corona is extended in the disk plane, whereas the high values of polarisation degree that we are observing hint that our theoretical models are incomplete. Magnetars, as expected, are observed to be very highly polarised, whereas the modest polarisation of X-ray pulsars is challenging theoretical models. IXPE has also tracked light echoes from a probable tidal disruption event by Sgr A* that occurred 150 years ago.

AI.abstract_translation: 我将回顾IXPE围绕银河系源取得的众多科学亮点中的一部分。IXPE通过观测银河系源产出了丰富且具有高度影响力的科学成果。例如，它显著影响了我们对黑洞X射线双星系统的理解。偏振方向与射电喷流对齐的观测表明冕分布在盘面方向上展宽，而我们观测到的高偏振度值则暗示我们的理论模型是不完整的。磁星如预期那样被观测到具有非常高的偏振度，而X射线脉冲星的适度偏振则对理论模型构成挑战。IXPE还追踪到了可能由Sgr A*在150年前发生的潮汐瓦解事件所产生光的回声。

AI.method: 摘要未说明具体的观测日期、频段、样本数量或分析细节。该文为基于IXPE的观测回顾，涉及X射线偏振测量，比较了偏振方向与射电喷流、偏振度等量，并追踪光回声。
AI.result: 黑洞X射线双星中偏振方向与射电喷流对齐，表明冕在盘平面内展宽；观测到的高偏振度值提示理论模型不完整。磁星被观测到具有非常高的偏振度；X射线脉冲星则呈适度偏振，这一结果对理论模型构成挑战。IXPE还追踪了可能由Sgr A*约150年前发生的潮汐瓦解事件产生的光回声。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为IXPE的银河系源观测产出了丰富且高度影响的科学成果，尤其在黑洞X射线双星方面，并指出磁星高偏振与X射线脉冲星适度偏振的现象需要进一步完善理论模型。根据摘要无法判断其方法与结果对脉冲星计时、单脉冲或FRB等研究的直接适用性。

title: Soft Gamma-Ray Polarimetry with the Compton Spectrometer and Imager
summary: The Compton Spectrometer and Imager (COSI) is a NASA Small Explorer (SMEX) satellite mission in development with a planned launch into low-Earth orbit in 2027. COSI is a wide-field gamma-ray telescope designed to survey the entire sky at 0.2-5 MeV. It provides imaging, spectroscopy, and polarimetry of astrophysical sources. Science goals for COSI include studies of 0.511 MeV emission from antimatter annihilation in the Galaxy, mapping radioactive elements from nucleosynthesis, detecting and localizing multimessenger sources, and determining emission mechanisms and source geometries with polarization measurements. Compton telescopes detect multiple interactions from individual incoming photons, allowing for scattering angles to be measured. After many photons are detected from a source, the distribution of azimuthal angles provides polarization information. COSI will measure the polarization of accreting black holes, gamma-ray bursts (GRBs), and pulsars. In this talk, we will describe the COSI instrument, its polarimetry science objectives, and a status update for the mission.

AI.abstract_translation: 康普顿谱仪与成像仪（COSI）是NASA小型探索（SMEX）卫星任务，正处于研制阶段，计划于2027年发射进入近地轨道。COSI是一台宽视场伽马射线望远镜，设计用于在0.2–5 MeV能量范围内巡测整个天区。它提供对天体物理源的成像、光谱和偏振测量。COSI的科学目标包括研究银河系内反物质湮灭产生的0.511 MeV发射、测绘来自核合成的放射性元素、探测并定位多信使源，以及利用偏振测量确定发射机制和源的几何结构。康普顿望远镜可探测单个入射光子的多次相互作用，从而能够测量散射角。当从某一源探测到许多光子后，方位角的分布即可提供偏振信息。COSI将测量吸积黑洞、伽马射线暴（GRBs）和脉冲星的偏振。在本次报告中，我们将介绍COSI仪器、其偏振测量科学目标以及任务的进展状态。

title: The High Energy cosmic-Radiation Detection Facility onboard the China Space Station—HERD for launch in 2029
summary: HERD, the world's highest-energy, widest-field-of-view, and largest-area space-based particle physics and astrophysics facility for detecting high-energy electrons, cosmic rays, and gamma rays, is scheduled for launch and installation onto the China Space Station in 2029 to operate over an extended period. Leveraging the China Space Station—the national space science laboratory—HERD will achieve unprecedented precision and energy range in measuring the energies and spatial distributions of cosmic high-energy electrons; determine the composition and energy spectra at the "knee"—the critical feature marking the transition between galactic and extragalactic cosmic-ray origins; conduct surveys of the dynamic high-energy gamma-ray sky; search for potential signals of dark matter particle annihilation or decay; deepen our understanding of the origin and propagation of high-energy cosmic rays; and make significant contributions to the identification of high-energy neutrino astrophysical sources, observations of gamma-ray pulsars, and gravitational-wave detection.

AI.abstract_translation: HERD是世界能量最高、视场最宽、面积最大的天基粒子物理与天体物理探测设施，用于探测高能电子、宇宙线和伽马射线，计划于2029年发射并安装到中国空间站上，进行长期运行。依托中国空间站这一国家级空间科学实验室，HERD将以前所未有的精度和能量范围测量宇宙高能电子的能量与空间分布；确定“膝”—标志银河系内与银河系外宇宙线起源转变的关键特征—处的成分与能谱；对动态的高能伽马射线天空进行巡天；搜寻暗物质粒子湮灭或衰变的潜在信号；加深我们对高能宇宙线起源与传播的理解；并对高能中微子天体物理源的证认、伽马射线脉冲星的观测以及引力波探测作出重要贡献。

title: Using TeV observations from HAWC and LHAASO gamma-ray measurements to improve the modeling of the highest energy cosmic rays produced in the Milky Way
summary: The latest observations by the High-Altitude Water Cherenkov Gamma-Ray Observatory (HAWC) and the Large High Altitude Air Shower Observatory (LHAASO) can be used to test the assumptions on the sources of TeV-scale cosmic rays as well as the propagation assumptions of those cosmic rays within the Milky Way's interstellar medium. Including updates on the boron-to-carbon, and the beryllium isotopes cosmic-ray ratios from the Alpha Magnetic Spectrometer at GeV energies, the TeV gamma-ray measurements can transform our understanding of cosmic rays at the TeV scale. I will show results where we use the LHAASO observations at 1-100 TeV gamma-ray energies as well as measurements of same energy scale neutrinos from the IcCube Neutrino Observatory. We test alternative models on the averaged properties of the Milky Way's interstellar medium conditions relying on modeling them via the GALPROP comic-ray propagation code; which also allows to calculate the diffuse gamma-ray emission at these energies. Furthermore, in our work we include the gamma-ray emission from TeV-halos associated to pulsars as those that have been detected in the HAWC observations.

AI.abstract_translation: 高海拔水切连科夫伽马射线天文台（HAWC）和大型高海拔空气簇射观测站（LHAASO）的最新观测可用于检验对TeV尺度宇宙射线源的假设，以及这些宇宙射线在银河系星际介质中传播的假设。结合阿尔法磁谱仪在GeV能量上对硼碳比和铍同位素宇宙射线比的更新，TeV伽马射线测量可以转变我们对TeV尺度宇宙射线的理解。我将展示我们利用LHAASO在1-100 TeV伽马射线能量上的观测以及来自冰立方中微子天文台（IcCube）同能量尺度中微子测量的结果。我们检验了关于银河系星际介质平均性质的不同模型，这些模型依赖GALPROP宇宙射线传播代码进行建模，该代码也能够计算这些能量上的弥散伽马射线发射。此外，在我们的工作中，我们包含了与脉冲星相关的TeV晕的伽马射线发射，如HAWC观测中已探测到的那些晕。
AI.tldr: 该工作利用HAWC和LHAASO的TeV伽马射线观测及冰立方中微子数据，结合AMS的GeV宇宙射线比值，通过GALPROP传播代码改进对银河系内最高能宇宙射线源与传播模型的建模，并纳入与脉冲星相关的TeV晕发射。
AI.motivation: 在TeV尺度上，对银河系内宇宙射线的源假设及在星际介质中的传播假设仍缺乏有效检验。最新的HAWC和LHAASO观测，配合AMS在GeV能量上的宇宙射线比值更新，可用于检验并改进对这些最高能宇宙射线建模的认识。
AI.method: 摘要说明：使用HAWC与LHAASO在1-100 TeV伽马射线能量的观测，以及冰立方天文台（IcCube）同能量尺度的中微子测量，并纳入AMS的硼碳比与铍同位素宇宙射线比；通过GALPROP宇宙射线传播代码建模银河系星际介质的平均性质并计算弥散伽马射线发射，同时包含与脉冲星相关的TeV晕发射。时间跨度、样本量与样本频次等细节摘要未说明。
AI.result: 摘要表明，TeV伽马射线测量结合GeV宇宙射线比值更新，可转变对TeV尺度宇宙射线源及传播假设的理解；作者将展示利用LHAASO在1-100 TeV能量观测及冰立方（IcCube）同能级中微子测量的结果，检验以GALPROP代码建模的星际介质平均性质的不同模型，并纳入HAWC已探测到的与脉冲星相关TeV晕的伽马射线发射。摘要未给出具体数值或统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出，结合TeV伽马射线测量与传播模型可改进对银河系内最高能宇宙射线建模的理解，并强调脉冲星TeV晕对弥散伽马射线发射的贡献。关于该方法对脉冲星、磁星或FRB等领域具体的物理可转移性，根据摘要无法判断。

title: NSF's GEM Focus Group on Comparative Processes in Planetary Magnetospheres
summary: The Solar System is gifted with a diverse array of magnetospheric systems, from the familiar Dungey-cycle-driven system at Earth, to the extreme Vasyliunas-cycle-driven Gas Giants, to the unmagnetized-solar wind interactions found at Mars and Venus. Together, this diverse set of planetary magnetospheres makes it possible to probe fundamental physical processes by exploring how and under what conditions they operate in and across the Solar System. Furthermore, if we can make sense of this large parameter regime, not only will we improve our understanding of the geospace environment, we may also be able to close the gap in our understanding of plasma physics elsewhere in the cosmos, e.g., magnetospheres of pulsars and brown dwarfs. However, to reach that goal, it requires the Earth and Planetary space physics communities to give serious consideration to the physics behind the similarities and differences between these systems. Fortunately, the Geospace Environment Modeling (GEM) program—which is sponsored by the National Science Foundation (NSF)—has a focus group on Comparative planetary Magnetospheric Processes (COMP). In this presentation, we will provide a summary of the COMP efforts that have been underway since its inaugural session in 2023 as well as a list of community-solicited questions and strategies to pursue in the coming decade. Finally, we will conclude on ways for anyone interested to participate and contribute in upcoming GEM workshops.

AI.abstract_translation: 太阳系拥有多种多样的磁层系统，从地球上熟悉的Dungey循环驱动的系统，到极端情况下由Vasyliunas循环驱动的巨行星，再到在火星和金星上发现的无磁化太阳风相互作用。总之，这一多样化的行星磁层集合使我们有可能通过探索基本物理过程在太阳系内及其各处如何以及在何种条件下运作来对其进行研究。此外，如果我们能理解这一庞大的参数区间，那么不仅将增进我们对地球空间环境的理解，还可能让我们在理解宇宙中其他地方（例如脉冲星和褐矮星的磁层）的等离子体物理方面缩小差距。然而，要达到这一目标，需要地球和行星空间物理学界认真思考这些系统之间相似性与差异性背后的物理学。幸运的是，由国家科学基金会（NSF）资助的地球空间环境建模（GEM）计划有一个关于比较行星磁层过程（COMP）的重点小组。在本报告中，我们将总结自2023年首届会议以来一直在开展的COMP工作，以及在接下来十年中需要推进的由社区征询的问题与策略清单。最后，我们将说明任何有兴趣的人如何参与并为即将举行的GEM研讨会作出贡献。
AI.tldr: 本文介绍NSF的GEM计划中关于比较行星磁层过程的COMP重点小组。该报告的结论是：通过对太阳系内多样化的磁层系统进行系统比较，不仅能加深对地球空间环境的理解，还有望缩小对宇宙中其他等离子体系统（如脉冲星与褐矮星的磁层）认知方面的差距。
AI.motivation: 太阳系拥有从Dungey循环驱动的类地系统到Vasyliunas循环驱动的巨行星、再到火星与金星无磁化太阳风相互作用的多样磁层系统。作者指出，理解这些系统在巨大参数区间内的运作有助于推进基本物理过程的研究，并可能弥合对邻近等离子体系统（如脉冲星与褐矮星磁层）物理理解上的差距。
AI.method: 本文是一份关于GEM计划中COMP（比较行星磁层过程）重点小组的活动总结报告。方法上，报告总结了COMP自2023年首届会议以来的工作努力、汇总的社区征询问题清单，以及未来十年应推进的策略，并就参与方式作出说明。摘要未说明具体观测数据、仪器、频率或分析方法。
AI.result: 本报告呈现了COMP重点小组自2023年首届会议以来已开展的工作情况总结，并提供了一份由社区征询产生的问题与策略清单以供下一个十年推进。报告最后给出了有兴趣者参与并为即将举行的GEM研讨会作出贡献的途径。摘要中未报告具体的磁层物理测量结果或数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出，对太阳系多样化行星磁层进行比较研究可以探测其内部运作的基本物理过程；理解其庞大参数区间不仅可提升对地球空间环境的理解，还可能缩小对宇宙中其他等离子体系统（如脉冲星与褐矮星磁层）认知的差距。请注意，这就对脉冲星的提示来自摘要对该浩瀚参数区间意义的推测性表述，并非本文所报告的实际观测结果。根据摘要无法判断COMP成果对脉冲星、磁星或FRB研究的具体可转移性。

title: Particle Acceleration and Transport in the Earth's Diamagnetic Cavities
summary: Diamagnetic cavities (DMCs) in Earth's magnetosphere are weak─magnetic-field, high─plasma-beta regions that form around the high-altitude cusp funnel. They act as reservoirs for energetic particles and enable efficient perpendicular particle acceleration. DMCs are created by large-scale magnetic reconnection that drives the global plasma circulation known as the Dungey cycle. In addition, the DMCs are magnetically and structurally equivalent to the standard solar flare model for describing the plasma dynamics, transport and evolution during the eruption process. Thus, the investigation of the Earth's DMCs is important for the readily available in-situ spacecraft measurements. Previous studies have suggested that particles are energized up to hundreds keV when their curvature and gradient drift align with the gradient of reconnection quasi-potential. With the combination analysis from test-particle simulation and Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) mission, a scaling law of particle acceleration ∆∊ = α m_i V_A^2 is given, enabling the straightforward examination and prediction for energization processes in various astrophysical and even exoplanetary plasma environments, such as the solar corona, pulsars, active galactic nuclei, etc. Further, the typical plasma mass estimated contained within the DMCs is 45 times sufficient to populate the plasma sheet in the magnetotail. These emphasize the important role of Earth's DMCs in particle acceleration and transport within the global dynamics of the planetary magnetosphere.

AI.abstract_translation: 地球磁层中的抗磁性空腔（DMCs）是弱磁场、高等离子体β的区域，它们环绕高海拔尖点漏斗形成。它们充当能量粒子的储库，并能够实现高效的垂直粒子加速。DMCs由大规模的磁重联所产生，这种重联驱动着被称为邓基循环（Dungey cycle）的全球等离子体环流。此外，DMCs在磁性与结构上等同于标准太阳耀斑模型，用于描述爆发过程中的等离子体动力学、输运和演化。因此，对地球DMCs的研究对于可随时利用的就地（in-situ）航天器测量具有重要意义。先前的研究表明，当粒子的曲率漂移和梯度漂移与重联准势的梯度方向一致时，粒子可被加速至数百keV的量级。结合测试粒子模拟与磁层多尺度（MMS）任务的综合分析，给出了粒子加速的标度律 ∆∊ = α m_i V_A^2，从而能够对各种天体物理甚至系外行星等离子体环境（如太阳冕、脉冲星、活动星系核等）中的赋能过程进行直接的检验与预测。此外，DMCs内所含的典型等离子体质量足以填充磁尾等离子体片，其量约为后者的45倍。这些结果强调了地球DMCs在行星磁层全球动力学中粒子加速与输运方面的重要作用。
AI.tldr: 论文研究地球磁层抗磁性空腔（DMC）中的粒子加速与输运，结合测试粒子模拟与MMS任务数据给出加速标度律 ∆∊ = α m_i V_A^2，并指出DMC内所含典型等离子体质量足以45倍填充磁尾等离子体片。
AI.motivation: 抗磁性空腔因可提供就地的航天器测量而成为研究粒子加速与输运的重要对象；其磁性与结构等价于标准太阳耀斑模型，且其加速标度律可推广至太阳冕、脉冲星、活动星系核等天体物理环境，因此值得深入研究。
AI.method: 摘要说明：DMC为弱磁场、高等离子体β区域，由大规模磁重联产生。作者结合测试粒子（test-particle）模拟与磁层多尺度（MMS）任务的综合分析，推导粒子加速标度律，并估算DMC内所含的典型等离子体质量。其余观测细节、时间跨度与样本等未说明。
AI.result: 摘要报告：结合测试粒子模拟与MMS任务综合分析，给出粒子加速标度律 ∆∊ = α m_i V_A^2，可检验和预测各种等离子体环境的赋能过程；DMC内典型的等离子体质量约为填充磁尾等离子体片所需质量的45倍；先前研究表明当曲率与梯度漂移与重联准势梯度一致时粒子可被加速至数百keV量级。
AI.conclusion: 结论：地球DMC在行星磁层全球动力学中粒子加速与输运方面发挥重要作用，且该加速标度律或可用于各类天体物理环境的预测。需要说明：摘要提及“脉冲星”仅为该模型可应用环境的举例，本文并非针对脉冲星、磁星或FRB的研究；其向这些主题的转移结论，根据摘要无法判断。

title: From explosions to jets: The transient millimetre Universe in the 2040s
summary: The 2040s will be a golden era for time-domain and multi-messenger astrophysics, but many decisive phases of transient evolution are best seen at millimeter/sub-millimeter (mm/sub-mm) wavelengths, where suitably capable instruments are still lacking. mm/sub-mm uniquely probes early shock and jet emission, penetrate dust-enshrouded environments and reveal magnetic-field geometry providing key information on the physical properties of the sources. In this talk, I will describe how planned facilities such as the next-generation interferometer ALMA2040 and the wide-field single-dish telescope AtLAST could fill this gap. Wide-field monitoring and rapid tiling of large localization regions from gravitational-wave and neutrino alerts enable efficient counterpart identification. Rapid-response, broadband, full-Stokes interferometric follow-up with large sensitivity gains, simultaneous multi-frequency coverage, long baselines and VLBI compatibility can convert those detections into quantitative constraints on energetics, environments and magnetic structure. These capabilities will reshape studies of interaction-powered supernovae, novae and stellar mergers, and of engine-driven explosions such as GRBs, fast blue optical transients and tidal disruption events. They will also enable sharper view to jets from X-ray binaries and AGN, and fast coherent transients such as magnetars, pulsars and repeating FRBs. Next-generation mm facilities will make mm/sub-mm time-domain observations a core part of multi-messenger discovery and interpretation in the 2040s, and will deliver legacy datasets that map the transient millimetre sky for decades.

AI.abstract_translation: 2040年代将是时域和多信使天体物理学的黄金时代，但暂现源演化的许多决定性阶段在毫米/亚毫米（mm/sub-mm）波长上才能得到最佳观测，而目前仍缺乏具有相应能力的仪器。mm/sub-mm能够独特地探测早期激波和喷流辐射，穿透尘埃遮蔽的环境并揭示磁场几何结构，从而提供关于源物理性质的关键信息。在本报告中，我将描述诸如下一代干涉仪ALMA2040和宽视场单碟望远镜AtLAST等拟议设施如何填补这一空白。来自引力波和中微子警报的大范围定位区域的宽视场监测与快速镶嵌观测，能够实现高效的同源体识别。具有大幅灵敏度增益、同时多频率覆盖、长基线和VLBI兼容性的快速响应、宽带、全斯托克斯干涉测量后续观测，可以将这些探测转化为对能量学、环境和磁场结构的定量约束。这些能力将重塑对碰撞供能超新星、新星和恒星并合的研究，以及对引擎驱动的爆炸（如GRB、快速蓝色光学暂现源和潮汐瓦解事件）的研究。它们还将使人们能够更清晰地观测来自X射线双星和活动星系核的喷流，以及诸如磁星、脉冲星和重复FRB等快速相干暂现源。下一代毫米设施将使mm/sub-mm时域观测成为2040年代多信使发现与解释的核心组成部分，并将提供绘制暂现毫米天图、可供数十年的遗留数据集。
AI.tldr: 本文展望2040年代毫米/亚毫米时域天文学的机遇，指出下一代设施ALMA2040与AtLAST可通过宽视场监测、快速镶嵌及宽带全斯托克斯干涉测量后续观测，填补引力波、中微子等多信使暂现源在mm/sub-mm波段的观测空白。
AI.motivation: 暂现源演化的许多决定性阶段最适宜在mm/sub-mm波段观测，但现有仪器尚缺乏相应能力，造成时域与多信使天体物理中的关键观测空缺，本文旨在探讨拟议的下一代设施如何填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文为展望性报告。描述了拟议设施ALMA2040（下一代干涉仪）和AtLAST（宽视场单碟望远镜）；提出宽视场监测、对引力波与中微子警报定位区域的快速镶嵌观测、同源体识别，以及快速响应、宽带、全斯托克斯干涉测量后续观测，并提及同时多频率覆盖、长基线与VLBI兼容性。摘要未说明具体观测数据、频率范围或时间跨度。
AI.result: 摘要指出mm/sub-mm能独特地探测早期激波与喷流辐射、穿透尘埃遮蔽并揭示磁场几何。所述能力可将多信使探测转化为对能量学、环境与磁场结构的定量约束；并将重塑对碰撞供能超新星、新星、恒星并合、GRB、快速蓝色光学暂现源、潮汐瓦解事件等的研究，实现对X射线双星与活动星系核喷流的更清晰观测。摘要未给出具体数值或显著性结果。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，下一代毫米设施将使mm/sub-mm时域观测成为2040年代多信使发现与解释的核心部分，并产出可长期绘制暂现毫米天图的遗留数据集。摘要明确提及此类设施有望用于磁星、脉冲星与重复FRB等快速相干暂现源研究，作者对此给出方向性展望；关于具体物理结论，根据摘要无法判断。
